entry.summary: Studies heterogeneous multi-agent LLM systems and discovers that strong-weak model collaboration can underperform weak-weak combinations due to cognitive mismatching. Proposes entropy-based understanding assessment and experience retrieval to guide collaboration.

entry.title: AllMem: A Memory-centric Recipe for Efficient Long-context Modeling

author.name: Ziming Wang, Xiang Wang, Kailong Peng, Lang Qin, Juan Gabriel Kostelec, Christos Sourmpis, Axel Laborieux, Qinghai Guo

entry.summary: AllMem combines Sliding Window Attention with non-linear Test-Time Training memory networks for ultra-long context modeling, mitigating catastrophic forgetting while reducing computational overhead compared to full attention.

entry.title: Can a Lightweight Automated AI Pipeline Solve Research-Level Mathematical Problems?

author.name: Lve Meng (University of Science, Technology of China, Zhongguancun Academy), Weilong Zhao (Universit\'e Paris Cit\'e), Yanzhi Zhang (Zhongguancun Academy), Haoxiang Guan (Zhongguancun Academy), Jiyan He (Zhongguancun Academy)

entry.summary: Demonstrates that a lightweight automated pipeline using next-gen models (Gemini 3 Pro, GPT-5.2 Pro) with citation-based verification can solve research-grade mathematical problems, evaluated on two novel datasets.

entry.title: Neuromem: A Granular Decomposition of the Streaming Lifecycle in External Memory for LLMs

author.name: Ruicheng Zhang, Xinyi Li, Tianyi Xu, Shuhao Zhang, Xiaofei Liao, Hai Jin

entry.summary: Neuromem benchmarks external memory modules under realistic streaming conditions with interleaved insertion-and-retrieval, decomposing the memory lifecycle into five dimensions. Reveals that static evaluation doesn't predict streaming performance.

entry.title: Plan-MCTS: Plan Exploration for Action Exploitation in Web Navigation

author.name: Weiming Zhang, Jihong Wang, Jiamu Zhou, Qingyao Li, Xinbei Ma, Congmin Zheng, Xingyu Lou, Weiwen Liu, Zhuosheng Zhang, Jun Wang, Yong Yu, Weinan Zhang

entry.summary: Plan-MCTS reformulates web navigation by shifting MCTS exploration to a semantic Plan Space, decoupling strategic planning from execution. Creates a Dense Plan Tree for efficient exploration and Abstracted Semantic History for state awareness.

entry.title: ForesightSafety Bench: A Frontier Risk Evaluation and Governance Framework towards Safe AI

author.name: Haibo Tong, Feifei Zhao, Linghao Feng, Ruoyu Wu, Ruolin Chen, Lu Jia, Zhou Zhao, Jindong Li, Tenglong Li, Erliang Lin, Shuai Yang, Enmeng Lu, Yinqian Sun, Qian Zhang, Zizhe Ruan, Zeyang Yue, Ping Wu, Huangrui Li, Chengyi Sun, Yi Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes ForesightSafety Bench, a comprehensive AI safety evaluation framework covering 7 fundamental safety pillars extending to embodied AI, AI4Science, social risks, and catastrophic scenarios. Aims to address limitations of current safety benchmarks.

entry.title: World Models for Policy Refinement in StarCraft II

author.name: Yixin Zhang, Ziyi Wang, Yiming Rong, Haoxi Wang, Jinling Jiang, Shuang Xu, Haoran Wu, Shiyu Zhou, Bo Xu

entry.summary: Proposes StarWM, the first world model for StarCraft II that predicts future observations under partial observability, using structured textual representations and a factorized observation space to guide LLM-based decision-making.

entry.title: Real-World Design and Deployment of an Embedded GenAI-powered 9-1-1 Calltaking Training System: Experiences and Lessons Learned

author.name: Zirong Chen, Meiyi Ma

entry.summary: Reports on real-world deployment of a GenAI-powered 911 call-taker training system with Metro Nashville, scaling to 190 operational users. Addresses critical staffing shortages in emergency communications.

entry.title: Boltz is a Strong Baseline for Atom-level Representation Learning

author.name: Hyosoon Jang, Hyunjin Seo, Yunhui Jang, Seonghyun Park, Sungsoo Ahn

entry.summary: Shows that Boltz, a protein co-folding model operating at atom-level granularity, provides surprisingly strong baseline representations for small-molecule property prediction tasks like ADMET.

entry.title: Directional Concentration Uncertainty: A representational approach to uncertainty quantification for generative models

author.name: Souradeep Chattopadhyay, Brendan Kennedy, Sai Munikoti, Soumik Sarkar, Karl Pazdernik

entry.summary: Proposes Directional Concentration Uncertainty (DCU), a statistical framework for uncertainty quantification in generative models using von Mises-Fisher distribution to measure geometric dispersion of embeddings.

entry.title: HiST-VLA: A Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Vision-Language-Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yiru Wang, Zichong Gu, Yu Gao, Anqing Jiang, Zhigang Sun, Shuo Wang, Yuwen Heng, Hao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes HiST-VLA, a hierarchical spatio-temporal vision-language-action model for autonomous driving that enhances 3D spatial and temporal reasoning with dynamic token sparsification for efficiency. Addresses VLA limitations in safety-critical driving scenarios.

entry.title: Assessing Spear-Phishing Website Generation in Large Language Model Coding Agents

author.name: Tailia Malloy, Tegawende F. Bissyande

entry.summary: Assesses the capability of LLM coding agents to generate spear-phishing websites, examining the security implications of increasingly autonomous programming agents in cybersecurity contexts.

entry.title: Metabolic cost of information processing in Poisson variational autoencoders

author.name: Hadi Vafaii, Jacob L. Yates

entry.summary: Explores metabolic cost of information processing in Poisson variational autoencoders, showing that KL divergence becomes proportional to prior firing rates, creating an emergent metabolic cost that couples coding rate to firing rate.

entry.title: FlowHOI: Flow-based Semantics-Grounded Generation of Hand-Object Interactions for Dexterous Robot Manipulation

author.name: Huajian Zeng, Lingyun Chen, Jiaqi Yang, Yuantai Zhang, Fan Shi, Peidong Liu, Xingxing Zuo

entry.summary: Proposes FlowHOI, a two-stage flow-matching framework for generating semantically grounded hand-object interaction sequences conditioned on egocentric observations, language instructions, and 3D Gaussian splatting scene reconstructions.

entry.title: Arming Data Agents with Tribal Knowledge

author.name: Shubham Agarwal, Asim Biswal, Sepanta Zeighami, Alvin Cheung, Joseph Gonzalez, Aditya G. Parameswaran

entry.summary: Proposes a system for enhancing NL2SQL agents with 'tribal knowledge' - implicit knowledge about how to correctly use database data that goes beyond simple facts. Addresses misconceptions that NL2SQL agents form about real-world databases.

entry.title: AuTAgent: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Tool-Augmented Audio Reasoning

author.name: Siqian Tong, Xuan Li, Yiwei Wang, Baolong Bi, Yujun Cai, Shenghua Liu, Yuchen He, Chengpeng Hao

entry.summary: Proposes AuTAgent, a reinforcement learning framework for audio reasoning that learns when and which external tools to invoke using a differential reward mechanism, avoiding information overload from naive tool use.

entry.title: Pailitao-VL: Unified Embedding and Reranker for Real-Time Multi-Modal Industrial Search

author.name: Lei Chen, Chen Ju, Xu Chen, Zhicheng Wang, Yuheng Jiao, Hongfeng Zhan, Zhaoyang Li, Shihao Xu, Zhixiang Zhao, Tong Jia, Jinsong Lan, Xiaoyong Zhu, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: Presents Pailitao-VL, an industrial multi-modal retrieval system shifting from contrastive learning to ID-recognition for embeddings and using a VLM-based reranker. Deployed at scale in production.

entry.title: MOTIF: Learning Action Motifs for Few-shot Cross-Embodiment Transfer

author.name: Heng Zhi, Wentao Tan, Lei Zhu, Fengling Li, Jingjing Li, Guoli Yang, Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: Introduces MOTIF for few-shot cross-embodiment transfer that decouples embodiment-agnostic spatiotemporal patterns ('action motifs') from heterogeneous action data using vector quantization with progress-aware alignment.

entry.title: MechPert: Mechanistic Consensus as an Inductive Bias for Unseen Perturbation Prediction

author.name: Marc Boubnovski Martell, Josefa Lia Stoisser, Lawrence Phillips, Aditya Misra, Robert Kitchen, Jesper Ferkinghoff-Borg, Jialin Yu, Philip Torr, Kaspar M\"arten

entry.summary: Introduces MechPert, a framework using multiple LLM agents to generate directed regulatory hypotheses for predicting transcriptional responses to unseen genetic perturbations, aggregated through consensus mechanism.

entry.title: Mean Flow Policy with Instantaneous Velocity Constraint for One-step Action Generation

author.name: Guojian Zhan, Letian Tao, Pengcheng Wang, Yixiao Wang, Yiheng Li, Yuxin Chen, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Shengbo Eben Li

entry.summary: Proposes Mean Velocity Policy (MVP) for one-step action generation in RL using mean velocity fields with an instantaneous velocity constraint, achieving fast and expressive policy generation.

entry.title: Pawsterior: Variational Flow Matching for Structured Simulation-Based Inference

author.name: Jorge Carrasco-Pollo, Floor Eijkelboom, Jan-Willem van de Meent

entry.summary: Introduces Pawsterior, a variational flow-matching framework for simulation-based inference that handles structured domains (bounded parameters, hybrid discrete-continuous variables) through endpoint-induced affine geometric confinement.

entry.title: Sufficient Conditions for Stability of Minimum-Norm Interpolating Deep ReLU Networks

author.name: Ouns El Harzli, Yoonsoo Nam, Ilja Kuzborskij, Bernardo Cuenca Grau, Ard A. Louis

entry.summary: Establishes sufficient conditions for algorithmic stability of deep ReLU networks that achieve minimum-norm interpolation (zero training error with smallest L2 norm parameters). Provides theoretical generalization guarantees for overparameterized deep networks.

entry.title: EIDOS: Latent-Space Predictive Learning for Time Series Foundation Models

author.name: Xinxing Zhou, Qingren Yao, Yiji Zhao, Chenghao Liu, Flora Salim, Xiaojie Yuan, Yanlong Wen, Ming Jin

entry.summary: Introduces EIDOS, a time series foundation model family that shifts pretraining from future value prediction to latent-space predictive learning, encouraging structured temporal representations via causal Transformer.

entry.title: Evaluating LLMs in Finance Requires Explicit Bias Consideration

author.name: Yaxuan Kong, Hoyoung Lee, Yoontae Hwang, Alejandro Lopez-Lira, Bradford Levy, Dhagash Mehta, Qingsong Wen, Chanyeol Choi, Yongjae Lee, Stefan Zohren

entry.summary: Identifies five recurring biases (look-ahead, survivorship, narrative, objective, cost) in financial LLM evaluation, finding none discussed in more than 28% of 164 reviewed papers from 2023-2025.

entry.title: Does Socialization Emerge in AI Agent Society? A Case Study of Moltbook

author.name: Ming Li, Xirui Li, Tianyi Zhou

entry.summary: First large-scale systemic diagnosis of Moltbook AI agent society, introducing quantitative diagnostic framework measuring semantic stabilization, lexical turnover, influence persistence, and collective consensus in AI social systems.

entry.title: AXE: An Agentic eXploit Engine for Confirming Zero-Day Vulnerability Reports

author.name: Amirali Sajadi, Tu Nguyen, Kostadin Damevski, Preetha Chatterjee

entry.summary: Introduces AXE, a multi-agent framework for web application exploitation that validates vulnerability reports in a grey-box setting using CWE classification and code location metadata.

entry.title: InnoEval: On Research Idea Evaluation as a Knowledge-Grounded, Multi-Perspective Reasoning Problem

author.name: Shuofei Qiao, Yunxiang Wei, Xuehai Wang, Bin Wu, Boyang Xue, Ningyu Zhang, Hossein A. Rahmani, Yanshan Wang, Qiang Zhang, Keyan Ding, Jeff Z. Pan, Huajun Chen, Emine Yilmaz

entry.summary: Introduces InnoEval, a framework for evaluating research ideas as a knowledge-grounded multi-perspective reasoning problem, using heterogeneous deep knowledge search and multi-criteria assessment to reduce LLM-as-judge bias.

entry.title: WiSparse: Boosting LLM Inference Efficiency with Weight-Aware Mixed Activation Sparsity

author.name: Lei Chen, Yuan Meng, Xiaoyu Zhan, Zhi Wang, Wenwu Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes WiSparse, a training-free activation sparsity method for LLM inference that considers both activation and weight importance, with non-uniform sparsity ratios across blocks. Identifies that less significant activations may align with important weights.

entry.title: Socially-Weighted Alignment: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Systems

author.name: Furkan Mumcu, Yasin Yilmaz

entry.summary: Proposes Socially-Weighted Alignment (SWA), a game-theoretic framework for multi-agent LLM systems that balances individual agent objectives with group welfare via a social weight parameter. Derives a critical threshold for preventing system overload in congestion games.

entry.title: TikArt: Aperture-Guided Observation for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Hao Ding, Zhichuan Yang, Weijie Ge, Ziqin Gao, Chaoyi Lu, Lei Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces TikArt, an aperture-guided agent for fine-grained visual reasoning in MLLMs that uses a Think-Aperture-Observe loop with Zoom and Segment actions to focus on relevant image regions, converting visual cues to linguistic memory.

entry.title: Fluid-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shishir Sharma, Doina Precup, Theodore J. Perkins

entry.summary: Proposes fluid-agent environments where agents can create other agents during MARL training, presents game-theoretic solution concepts, and evaluates several MARL algorithms on fluid variants of standard benchmarks.

entry.title: Scale redundancy and soft gauge fixing in positively homogeneous neural networks

author.name: Rodrigo Carmo Terin

entry.summary: Interprets the scale redundancy in positively homogeneous neural networks as a gauge symmetry from physics, introduces gauge-adapted coordinates, and proposes a soft orbit-selection penalty that stabilizes training by suppressing scale drift.

entry.title: CT-Bench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Lesion Understanding in Computed Tomography

author.name: Qingqing Zhu, Qiao Jin, Tejas S. Mathai, Yin Fang, Zhizheng Wang, Yifan Yang, Maame Sarfo-Gyamfi, Benjamin Hou, Ran Gu, Praveen T. S. Balamuralikrishna, Kenneth C. Wang, Ronald M. Summers, Zhiyong Lu

entry.summary: Introduces CT-Bench, a benchmark with 20,335 lesions from 7,795 CT studies for evaluating multimodal models on lesion understanding, including localization, description, size estimation, and attribute categorization with 2,850 QA pairs.

entry.title: AnchorWeave: World-Consistent Video Generation with Retrieved Local Spatial Memories

author.name: Zun Wang, Han Lin, Jaehong Yoon, Jaemin Cho, Yue Zhang, Mohit Bansal

entry.summary: Introduces AnchorWeave, a memory-augmented video generation framework that maintains spatial consistency over long horizons by using local spatial memories and retrieval-based conditioning rather than globally reconstructed 3D scenes.

entry.title: Cold-Start Personalization via Training-Free Priors from Structured World Models

author.name: Avinandan Bose, Shuyue Stella Li, Faeze Brahman, Pang Wei Koh, Simon Shaolei Du, Yulia Tsvetkov, Maryam Fazel, Lin Xiao, Asli Celikyilmaz

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free approach to cold-start personalization by decomposing preference elicitation into offline structure discovery using world models and online questioning, addressing the routing problem of identifying which preference dimensions matter for each user.

entry.title: Optimal Regret for Policy Optimization in Contextual Bandits

author.name: Orin Levy, Yishay Mansour

entry.summary: Presents the first high-probability optimal regret bound for policy optimization in stochastic contextual multi-armed bandits with general offline function approximation. Achieves O(sqrt(K|A|log|F|)) regret.

entry.title: Position Encoding with Random Float Sampling Enhances Length Generalization of Transformers

author.name: Atsushi Shimizu, Shohei Taniguchi, Yutaka Matsuo

entry.summary: Introduces Random Float Sampling (RFS), a position encoding strategy using randomly sampled continuous values instead of discrete indices, improving length generalization in transformers. Compatible with existing PE schemes.

entry.title: MAGE: All-[MASK] Block Already Knows Where to Look in Diffusion LLM

author.name: Omin Kwon, Yeonjae Kim, Doyeon Kim, Minseo Kim, Yeonhong Park, Jae W. Lee

entry.summary: Proposes MAGE for block diffusion LLMs, discovering that attention at the first all-[MASK] denoising step reliably predicts important KV entries, enabling a single exact attention pass per block for training-free sparse denoising.

entry.title: Radial-VCReg: More Informative Representation Learning Through Radial Gaussianization

author.name: Yilun Kuang, Yash Dagade, Deep Chakraborty, Erik Learned-Miller, Randall Balestriero, Tim G. J. Rudner, Yann LeCun

entry.summary: Proposes Radial-VCReg, augmenting VCReg self-supervised learning with a radial Gaussianization loss that aligns feature norms with the Chi distribution. Proves this transforms a broader class of distributions towards normality. Co-authored by Yann LeCun.

entry.title: Learning State-Tracking from Code Using Linear RNNs

author.name: Julien Siems, Riccardo Grazzi, Kirill Kalinin, Hitesh Ballani, Babak Rahmani

entry.summary: Shows that linear RNNs capable of state-tracking succeed at code-based permutation composition tasks while Transformers fail, even in next-token prediction setting. Investigates why tracking state in code is difficult for Transformers.

entry.title: LiveNewsBench: Evaluating LLM Web Search Capabilities with Freshly Curated News

author.name: Yunfan Zhang, Kathleen McKeown, Smaranda Muresan

entry.summary: Introduces LiveNewsBench, a continuously updated benchmark for evaluating LLM web search capabilities using fresh news articles that require multi-hop search and reasoning. Ensures separation between internal knowledge and search ability.

entry.title: Why Self-Training Helps and Hurts: Denoising vs. Signal Forgetting

author.name: Mingqi Wu, Archer Y. Yang, Qiang Sun

entry.summary: Analyzes iterative self-training in overparameterized linear regression, deriving deterministic-equivalent recursions that separate two forces: signal forgetting (growing) and denoising (decaying), identifying an optimal early stopping point.

entry.title: GTS: Inference-Time Scaling of Latent Reasoning with a Learnable Gaussian Thought Sampler

author.name: Minghan Wang, Ye Bai, Thuy-Trang Vu, Ehsan Shareghi, Gholamreza Haffari

entry.summary: Proposes Gaussian Thought Sampler (GTS) for structured inference-time scaling in latent reasoning models, replacing heuristic perturbations with learnable context-dependent distributions for exploring reasoning trajectories.

entry.title: BPP: Long-Context Robot Imitation Learning by Focusing on Key History Frames

author.name: Max Sobol Mark, Jacky Liang, Maria Attarian, Chuyuan Fu, Debidatta Dwibedi, Dhruv Shah, Aviral Kumar

entry.summary: Addresses the problem of robot policies failing when conditioned on history due to spurious correlations, proposing BPP which identifies and focuses on key history frames. The paper analyzes why policies latch onto incidental features and shows this stems from limited coverage over possible histories during training.

entry.title: Beyond Words: Evaluating and Bridging Epistemic Divergence in User-Agent Interaction via Theory of Mind

author.name: Minyuan Ruan, Ziyue Wang, Kaiming Liu, Yunghwei Lai, Peng Li, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes evaluating epistemic divergence between users and LLM agents using Theory of Mind, formalizing ToM as a mechanism for detecting and resolving mismatches between user beliefs and environment states. Creates a benchmark for assessing this capability.

entry.title: PrivAct: Internalizing Contextual Privacy Preservation via Multi-Agent Preference Training

author.name: Yuhan Cheng, Hancheng Ye, Hai Helen Li, Jingwei Sun, Yiran Chen

entry.summary: Proposes PrivAct, a multi-agent learning framework that internalizes contextual privacy preservation into LLM agent behavior through preference training, rather than relying on brittle external inference-time interventions.

entry.title: Beyond Token-Level Policy Gradients for Complex Reasoning with Large Language Models

author.name: Mufan Xu, Kehai Chen, Xuefeng Bai, Zhengyu Niu, Muyun Yang, Tiejun Zhao, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-token Policy Gradient Optimization (MPO) that treats sequences of K consecutive tokens as unified semantic actions for policy gradient training, addressing the mismatch between token-level optimization and block-level reasoning.

entry.title: Rethinking the Role of LLMs in Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Xin Qiu, Junlong Tong, Yirong Sun, Yunpu Ma, Wei Zhang, Xiaoyu Shen

entry.summary: Conducts a large-scale study of LLM-based time series forecasting across 8 billion observations and 17 scenarios, demonstrating that LLMs do improve forecasting performance, especially in cross-domain generalization, contradicting prior claims of no benefit.

entry.title: Embed-RL: Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning-Driven Multimodal Embeddings

author.name: Haonan Jiang, Yuji Wang, Yongjie Zhu, Xin Lu, Wenyu Qin, Meng Wang, Pengfei Wan, Yansong Tang

entry.summary: Proposes Embed-RL, using reinforcement learning to train a Reasoner that produces evidential traceability Chain-of-Thought for universal multimodal embeddings. Bridges generative reasoning and discriminative retrieval.

entry.title: EgoSound: Benchmarking Sound Understanding in Egocentric Videos

author.name: Bingwen Zhu, Yuqian Fu, Qiaole Dong, Guolei Sun, Tianwen Qian, Yuzheng Wu, Danda Pani Paudel, Xiangyang Xue, Yanwei Fu

entry.summary: Introduces EgoSound, the first benchmark for evaluating egocentric sound understanding in multimodal LLMs, with a seven-task taxonomy spanning sound perception, spatial reasoning, and causal interaction.

entry.title: MedVAR: Towards Scalable and Efficient Medical Image Generation via Next-scale Autoregressive Prediction

author.name: Zhicheng He, Yunpeng Zhao, Junde Wu, Ziwei Niu, Zijun Li, Lanfen Lin, Yueming Jin

entry.summary: Introduces MedVAR, the first autoregressive foundation model for medical image synthesis using next-scale prediction, generating images coarse-to-fine with multi-scale representations useful for downstream tasks.

entry.title: YOLO26: A Comprehensive Architecture Overview and Key Improvements

author.name: Priyanto Hidayatullah, Refdinal Tubagus

entry.summary: Provides an architectural overview of YOLO26, highlighting key improvements including DFL elimination, NMS-free inference, ProgLoss+STAL, and MuSGD optimizer claiming 43% CPU inference speed boost.

entry.title: It's a Matter of Time: Three Lessons on Long-Term Motion for Perception

author.name: Willem Davison, Xinyue Hao, Laura Sevilla-Lara

entry.summary: Investigates what can be learned from long-term motion information using point tracks, finding that temporal representations contain rich information about actions, objects, materials, and spatial layout, sometimes surpassing images.

entry.title: Depth Completion as Parameter-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Bingxin Ke, Qunjie Zhou, Jiahui Huang, Xuanchi Ren, Tianchang Shen, Konrad Schindler, Laura Leal-Taix\'e, Shengyu Huang

entry.summary: Introduces CAPA, a parameter-efficient test-time adaptation framework for depth completion that freezes a 3D foundation model and updates only minimal parameters using sparse observations at inference time.

entry.title: Symmetry-Aware Fusion of Vision and Tactile Sensing via Bilateral Force Priors for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Wonju Lee, Matteo Grimaldi, Tao Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a Cross-Modal Transformer for fusing vision and tactile sensing in robotic insertion tasks, with physics-informed regularization encouraging bilateral force balance. Achieves 96.59% insertion success on the TacSL benchmark.

entry.title: ProAct: A Dual-System Framework for Proactive Embodied Social Agents

author.name: Zeyi Zhang, Zixi Kang, Ruijie Zhao, Yusen Feng, Biao Jiang, Libin Liu

entry.summary: ProAct is a dual-system framework for embodied social agents that separates a low-latency behavioral system for real-time interaction from a slower cognitive system for long-horizon social reasoning and proactive intent generation.

entry.title: Evolutionary design of thermodynamic logic gates and their heat emission

author.name: Stephen Whitelam

entry.summary: Uses genetic algorithms to program thermodynamic computers to implement logic operations where the total heat emitted by the control system is of similar magnitude to the information-bearing degrees of freedom, approaching practical relevance of Landauer's bound.

entry.title: Semantic-Contact Fields for Category-Level Generalizable Tactile Tool Manipulation

author.name: Kevin Yuchen Ma, Heng Zhang, Weisi Lin, Mike Zheng Shou, Yan Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Semantic-Contact Fields for tactile tool manipulation that bridge semantic planning from VLA models with precise contact-aware control, addressing the sim-to-real gap for tactile sensors through a unified contact representation.

entry.title: Direction Matters: Learning Force Direction Enables Sim-to-Real Contact-Rich Manipulation

author.name: Yifei Yang, Anzhe Chen, Zhenjie Zhu, Kechun Xu, Yunxuan Mao, Yufei Wei, Lu Chen, Rong Xiong, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Proposes learning force direction (rather than magnitude) for sim-to-real transfer in contact-rich manipulation, using a human-designed finite state machine controller as privileged supervision. Force directions are more robust to simulation inaccuracies than magnitudes.

entry.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of LLMs with Mixture of Space Experts

author.name: Buze Zhang, Jinkai Tao, Zilang Zeng, Neil He, Ali Maatouk, Menglin Yang, Rex Ying

entry.summary: Proposes Mixture of Space (MoS) for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of LLMs, using multiple geometric spaces (Euclidean, hyperbolic, spherical) simultaneously rather than a single manifold, with a routing mechanism to select appropriate spaces.

entry.title: Near-Optimal Regret for Policy Optimization in Contextual MDPs with General Offline Function Approximation

author.name: Orin Levy, Aviv Rosenberg, Alon Cohen, Yishay Mansour

entry.summary: Introduces OPO-CMDP, the first policy optimization algorithm for contextual MDPs with general offline function approximation, achieving near-optimal regret with optimal dependence on state and action spaces.

entry.title: MoRL: Reinforced Reasoning for Unified Motion Understanding and Generation

author.name: Hongpeng Wang, Zeyu Zhang, Wenhao Li, Hao Tang

entry.summary: Proposes MoRL for unified motion understanding and generation using supervised fine-tuning and RL with verifiable rewards. Introduces Chain-of-Motion test-time reasoning and constructs two 140K-sample CoT datasets.

entry.title: Artificial Organisations

author.name: William Waites

entry.summary: Proposes organizational design for multi-agent AI systems inspired by human institutions, using compartmentalization and adversarial review rather than individual alignment. Demonstrated through Perseverance Composition Engine with Composer/Corroborator/Critic roles.

entry.title: REMem: Reasoning with Episodic Memory in Language Agent

author.name: Yiheng Shu, Saisri Padmaja Jonnalagedda, Xiang Gao, Bernal Jim\'enez Guti\'errez, Weijian Qi, Kamalika Das, Huan Sun, Yu Su

entry.summary: REMem formalizes episodic memory for language agents with a two-phase framework: offline indexing converting experiences into hypergraph-based event representations, and reasoning over them. Addresses the gap between human episodic memory and agent memory systems.

entry.title: HyFunc: Accelerating LLM-based Function Calls for Agentic AI through Hybrid-Model Cascade and Dynamic Templating

author.name: Weibin Liao, Jian-guang Lou, Haoyi Xiong

entry.summary: HyFunc addresses inference latency in LLM function calls through three innovations: intent distillation into a 'soft token' by a large model, cascading to a small model for generation, and dynamic templating that skips boilerplate syntax.

entry.title: No Need to Train Your RDB Foundation Model

author.name: Linjie Xu, Yanlin Zhang, Quan Gan, Minjie Wang, David Wipf

entry.summary: Shows that relational database foundation models can avoid retraining for new prediction targets by using in-context learning with theoretically-grounded compression of variably-sized RDB neighborhoods into fixed-length ICL samples.

entry.title: Bounding Probabilities of Causation with Partial Causal Diagrams

author.name: Yuxuan Xie, Ang Li

entry.summary: Proposes a general framework for bounding probabilities of causation using partial causal information, formulated as optimization problems. Enables tighter bounds without requiring complete causal graphs or binary variable assumptions.

entry.title: Arbor: A Framework for Reliable Navigation of Critical Conversation Flows

author.name: Lu\'is Silva, Diogo Gon\c{c}alves, Catarina Farinha, Clara Matos, Lu\'is Ungaro

entry.summary: Presents Arbor, a framework for reliable LLM-based decision tree navigation in high-stakes domains like healthcare triage. Decomposes decision trees into node-level tasks with DAG-based orchestration to avoid prompt degradation.

entry.title: Hunt Globally: Deep Research AI Agents for Drug Asset Scouting in Investing, Business Development, and Search & Evaluation

author.name: Alisa Vinogradova, Vlad Vinogradov, Luba Greenwood, Ilya Yasny, Dmitry Kobyzev, Shoman Kasbekar, Kong Nguyen, Dmitrii Radkevich, Roman Doronin, Andrey Doronichev

entry.summary: Addresses drug asset scouting using deep research AI agents, noting that >85% of patent filings and ~30% of global drug development originate outside the US and in non-English channels. Evaluates current AI research agents' capabilities for multilingual pharmaceutical intelligence.

entry.title: Agentic Spatio-Temporal Grounding via Collaborative Reasoning

author.name: Heng Zhao, Yew-Soon Ong, Joey Tianyi Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes ASTG, an agentic framework for spatio-temporal video grounding that uses specialized spatial and temporal reasoning agents in a training-free, open-world scenario. Eliminates the need for heavy supervision by using collaborative agent-based reasoning.

entry.title: Protect$^*$: Steerable Retrosynthesis through Neuro-Symbolic State Encoding

author.name: Shreyas Vinaya Sathyanarayana, Shah Rahil Kirankumar, Sharanabasava D. Hiremath, Bharath Ramsundar

entry.summary: Introduces Protect*, a neuro-symbolic framework that grounds LLM generative capabilities in chemical logic for retrosynthesis, using 55+ SMARTS patterns and 40+ protecting groups to direct LLMs to avoid chemically sensitive molecular sites.

entry.title: Hierarchical Audio-Visual-Proprioceptive Fusion for Precise Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Siyuan Li, Jiani Lu, Yu Song, Xianren Li, Bo An, Peng Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical audio-visual-proprioceptive fusion framework for robotic manipulation that treats acoustic signals as sparse, contact-driven modality rather than assuming homogeneous modality roles.

entry.title: KorMedMCQA-V: A Multimodal Benchmark for Evaluating Vision-Language Models on the Korean Medical Licensing Examination

author.name: Byungjin Choi, Seongsu Bae, Sunjun Kweon, Edward Choi

entry.summary: Introduces KorMedMCQA-V, a Korean medical licensing exam multimodal benchmark with 1,534 questions and 2,043 images. Benchmarks 50+ VLMs showing significant performance gaps, with the best model achieving only 61.8%.

entry.title: Cumulative Utility Parity for Fair Federated Learning under Intermittent Client Participation

author.name: Stefan Behfar, Richard Mortier

entry.summary: Proposes cumulative utility parity for fair federated learning, evaluating whether clients receive comparable long-term benefit per participation opportunity rather than per training round, addressing systematic under-representation from intermittent participation.

entry.title: HybridFlow: A Two-Step Generative Policy for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Zhenchen Dong, Jinna Fu, Jiaming Wu, Shengyuan Yu, Fulin Chen, Yide Liu

entry.summary: Proposes HybridFlow, a two-step generative policy for robotic manipulation combining MeanFlow for global action generation with ReFlow refinement, balancing inference speed and precision.

entry.title: A Comparative Analysis of Social Network Topology in Reddit and Moltbook

author.name: Yiming Zhu, Gareth Tyson, Pan Hui

entry.summary: First comparative analysis of network topology between Moltbook (an AI-agent-only social network) and Reddit, examining structural differences between agent-driven and human-driven social networks using large-scale data.

entry.title: From SFT to RL: Demystifying the Post-Training Pipeline for LLM-based Vulnerability Detection

author.name: Youpeng Li, Fuxun Yu, Xinda Wang

entry.summary: First comprehensive study of the full post-training pipeline (SFT through RL) for LLM-based vulnerability detection, identifying practical guidelines including that rejection-sampling-based SFT outperforms rationalization-based approaches.

entry.title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Abstention-Aware Scientific Reasoning

author.name: Samir Abdaljalil, Erchin Serpedin, Hasan Kurban

entry.summary: Studies abstention-aware scientific reasoning where LLMs can choose to abstain rather than produce uncertain answers, decomposing claims into minimal conditions verified against evidence using NLI.

entry.title: DeepFusion: Accelerating MoE Training via Federated Knowledge Distillation from Heterogeneous Edge Devices

author.name: Songyuan Li, Jia Hu, Ahmed M. Abdelmoniem, Geyong Min, Haojun Huang, Jiwei Huang

entry.summary: Proposes DeepFusion, first scalable federated MoE training framework enabling knowledge distillation from heterogeneous edge devices to a central MoE model without requiring devices to host full models.

entry.title: The geometry of invariant learning: an information-theoretic analysis of data augmentation and generalization

author.name: Abdelali Bouyahia, Fr\'ed\'eric LeBlanc, Mario Marchand

entry.summary: Proposes an information-theoretic framework using mutual information bounds to explain how data augmentation promotes invariance and improves generalization. The framework models augmented distributions as compositions and provides tighter generalization bounds. This offers theoretical grounding for one of the most common practical techniques in ML.

entry.title: When OpenClaw AI Agents Teach Each Other: Peer Learning Patterns in the Moltbook Community

author.name: Eason Chen, Ce Guan, Ahmed Elshafiey, Zhonghao Zhao, Joshua Zekeri, Afeez Edeifo Shaibu, Emmanuel Osadebe Prince

entry.summary: Analyzes peer learning behaviors among AI agents in the Moltbook community (2.4M agents), finding evidence of genuine teaching, skill sharing, and collaborative knowledge building through educational data mining of posts and comments.

entry.title: Decoupled Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning via Hamiltonian Flow

author.name: Minh Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes decoupled continuous-time RL via Hamiltonian flow, separating value function V and advantage-rate q optimization using physics-inspired structure. Addresses the collapse of Q-functions as time gaps shrink in continuous-time settings.

entry.title: Universal Algorithm-Implicit Learning

author.name: Stefano Woerner, Seong Joon Oh, Christian F. Baumgartner

entry.summary: Introduces a theoretical framework for meta-learning defining practical universality and the distinction between algorithm-explicit and algorithm-implicit learning, along with TAIL, a transformer-based meta-learner working across varying domains and modalities.

entry.title: PhyScensis: Physics-Augmented LLM Agents for Complex Physical Scene Arrangement

author.name: Yian Wang, Han Yang, Minghao Guo, Xiaowen Qiu, Tsun-Hsuan Wang, Wojciech Matusik, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Chuang Gan

entry.summary: Proposes PhyScensis, physics-augmented LLM agents for generating physically plausible 3D scene arrangements with complex object relationships (contact, support, balance, containment), addressing limitations of prior asset placement methods.

entry.title: Out-of-Support Generalisation via Weight Space Sequence Modelling

author.name: Roussel Desmond Nzoyem

entry.summary: Reformulates out-of-support generalization as a sequence modeling task in weight space, where the training set is partitioned into concentric shells. WeightCaster framework yields interpretable uncertainty-aware OoS predictions.

entry.title: Zero-Order Optimization for LLM Fine-Tuning via Learnable Direction Sampling

author.name: Valery Parfenov, Grigoriy Evseev, Andrey Veprikov, Nikolay Bushkov, Stanislav Moiseev, Aleksandr Beznosikov

entry.summary: Proposes a policy-driven zero-order optimization framework for LLM fine-tuning that treats perturbation direction sampling as a learnable policy, reducing variance of gradient estimates. This enables memory-efficient fine-tuning without backpropagation.

entry.title: Synergistic Intra- and Cross-Layer Regularization Losses for MoE Expert Specialization

author.name: Rizhen Hu, Yuan Cao, Boao Kong, Mou Sun, Kun Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes two plug-and-play regularization losses for MoE models: intra-layer specialization (penalizing expert similarity) and cross-layer consistency (encouraging routing coherence). No architectural changes needed.

entry.title: LACONIC: Length-Aware Constrained Reinforcement Learning for LLM

author.name: Chang Liu, Yiran Zhao, Lawrence Liu, Yaoqi Ye, Csaba Szepesv\'ari, Lin F. Yang

entry.summary: Proposes LACONIC, a constrained RL method that enforces target token budgets during LLM training by combining task reward with adaptively scaled length-based costs. Addresses the verbosity problem in RL-trained LLMs.

entry.title: BEACONS: Bounded-Error, Algebraically-Composable Neural Solvers for Partial Differential Equations

author.name: Jonathan Gorard, Ammar Hakim, James Juno

entry.summary: Constructs formally-verified neural network PDE solvers (BEACONS) with rigorous convergence, stability, and conservation guarantees using the method of characteristics. Correctness guaranteed even in extrapolatory regimes.

entry.title: Variance-Reduced $(\varepsilon,\delta)-$Unlearning using Forget Set Gradients

author.name: Martin Van Waerebeke, Marco Lorenzi, Kevin Scaman, El Mahdi El Mhamdi, Giovanni Neglia

entry.summary: Proposes VRU, the first (ε,δ)-unlearning algorithm that directly uses forget set gradients for variance reduction, bridging the gap between theoretically guaranteed methods and empirical heuristics.

entry.title: MacroGuide: Topological Guidance for Macrocycle Generation

author.name: Alicja Maksymiuk, Alexandre Duplessis, Michael Bronstein, Alexander Tong, Fernanda Duarte, \.Ismail \.Ilkan Ceylan

entry.summary: Introduces MacroGuide, using Persistent Homology to guide molecular diffusion models toward generating macrocycles in both unconditional and protein-pocket-conditional settings. Co-authored by Michael Bronstein.

entry.title: Orthogonalized Multimodal Contrastive Learning with Asymmetric Masking for Structured Representations

author.name: Carolin Cissee, Raneen Younis, Zahra Ahmadi

entry.summary: Introduces COrAL, a principled multimodal contrastive learning method that explicitly disentangles shared, modality-specific, and synergistic information using orthogonalization and asymmetric masking. This addresses a known limitation of existing contrastive methods that predominantly capture redundant cross-modal signals.

entry.title: Towards Sparse Video Understanding and Reasoning

author.name: Chenwei Xu, Zhen Ye, Shang Wu, Weijian Li, Zihan Wang, Zhuofan Xia, Lie Lu, Pranav Maneriker, Fan Du, Manling Li, Han Liu

entry.summary: Presents REVISE, a multi-round agent for video QA that selectively samples informative frames and maintains a summary-as-state across rounds with early stopping. Introduces EAGER, an annotation-free reward for reinforcement fine-tuning of open-source VLMs.

entry.title: STATe-of-Thoughts: Structured Action Templates for Tree-of-Thoughts

author.name: Zachary Bamberger, Till R. Saenger, Gilad Morad, Ofra Amir, Brandon M. Stewart, Amir Feder

entry.summary: Proposes STATe-of-Thoughts, an interpretable inference-time compute method that searches over high-level reasoning patterns using discrete textual interventions rather than high-temperature sampling, improving both diversity and explainability.

entry.title: Activation-Space Uncertainty Quantification for Pretrained Networks

author.name: Richard Bergna, Stefan Depeweg, Sergio Calvo-Ordo\~nez, Jonathan Plenk, Alvaro Cartea, Jose Miguel Hern\'andez-Lobato

entry.summary: Introduces GAPA, a post-hoc method that replaces activation functions with GP activations to add uncertainty estimates to frozen pretrained networks while exactly preserving original predictions.

entry.title: The Interspeech 2026 Audio Reasoning Challenge: Evaluating Reasoning Process Quality for Audio Reasoning Models and Agents

author.name: Ziyang Ma, Ruiyang Xu, Yinghao Ma, Chao-Han Huck Yang, Bohan Li, Jaeyeon Kim, Jin Xu, Jinyu Li, Carlos Busso, Kai Yu, Eng Siong Chng, Xie Chen

entry.summary: Describes the Interspeech 2026 Audio Reasoning Challenge, the first shared task evaluating Chain-of-Thought quality in audio models. Introduces MMAR-Rubrics for assessing factuality and logic of reasoning chains, attracting 156 teams from 18 countries.

entry.title: FireRed-Image-Edit-1.0 Techinical Report

author.name: Super Intelligence Team, Changhao Qiao, Chao Hui, Chen Li, Cunzheng Wang, Dejia Song, Jiale Zhang, Jing Li, Qiang Xiang, Runqi Wang, Shuang Sun, Wei Zhu, Xu Tang, Yao Hu, Yibo Chen, Yuhao Huang, Yuxuan Duan, Zhiyi Chen, Ziyuan Guo

entry.summary: Presents FireRed-Image-Edit, a diffusion transformer for instruction-based image editing trained on a 1.6B-sample corpus through multi-stage training including pre-training, SFT, and RL, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

entry.title: AdaVBoost: Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs via Token-Level Adaptive Visual Attention Boosting

author.name: Jiacheng Zhang, Feng Liu, Chao Du, Tianyu Pang

entry.summary: Introduces AdaVBoost, which adaptively determines how much to boost visual attention at each generation step in Large Vision-Language Models, addressing the trade-off where fixed scaling can be too weak or too strong. Reduces hallucinations more effectively than static approaches.

entry.title: Elastic Diffusion Transformer

author.name: Jiangshan Wang, Zeqiang Lai, Jiarui Chen, Jiayi Guo, Hang Guo, Xiu Li, Xiangyu Yue, Chunchao Guo

entry.summary: Proposes Elastic Diffusion Transformer (E-DiT), an adaptive acceleration framework that exploits sample-varying sparsity in DiT to skip computations with minimal quality impact.

entry.title: Multi-Turn Adaptive Prompting Attack on Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: In Chong Choi, Jiacheng Zhang, Feng Liu, Yiliao Song

entry.summary: Proposes MAPA, a multi-turn adaptive prompting attack on large vision-language models that alternates text-vision attack actions per turn and adjusts trajectory through iterative refinement to amplify responses.

entry.title: Gaussian Mesh Renderer for Lightweight Differentiable Rendering

author.name: Xinpeng Liu, Fumio Okura

entry.summary: Proposes Gaussian Mesh Renderer (GMR), a lightweight differentiable mesh renderer that leverages 3DGS rasterization to render triangle meshes efficiently by analytically deriving Gaussians from mesh triangles.

entry.title: Advances in Global Solvers for 3D Vision

author.name: Zhenjun Zhao, Heng Yang, Bangyan Liao, Yingping Zeng, Shaocheng Yan, Yingdong Gu, Peidong Liu, Yi Zhou, Haoang Li, Javier Civera

entry.summary: First systematic survey of global solvers for 3D vision, covering Branch-and-Bound, Convex Relaxation, and Graduated Non-Convexity across ten core vision tasks from Wahba problem to bundle adjustment.

entry.title: CrisiSense-RAG: Crisis Sensing Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Rapid Disaster Impact Assessment

author.name: Yiming Xiao, Kai Yin, Ali Mostafavi

entry.summary: CrisiSense-RAG is a multimodal RAG framework for disaster impact assessment that addresses temporal misalignment between real-time human reports and delayed satellite imagery. It synthesizes heterogeneous data without disaster-specific fine-tuning to avoid underestimating flood extent.

entry.title: UAVGENT: A Language-Guided Distributed Control Framework

author.name: Ziyi Zhang, Xiyu Deng, Guannan Qu, Yorie Nakahira

entry.summary: UAVGENT presents a three-layer architecture for language-guided multi-drone control: human natural language instructions, LLM-based supervision with verification, and a distributed inner-loop controller with formal tracking guarantees under bounded disturbances.

entry.title: RoboAug: One Annotation to Hundreds of Scenes via Region-Contrastive Data Augmentation for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Xinhua Wang, Kun Wu, Zhen Zhao, Hu Cao, Yinuo Zhao, Zhiyuan Xu, Meng Li, Shichao Fan, Di Wu, Yixue Zhang, Ning Liu, Zhengping Che, Jian Tang

entry.summary: RoboAug is a generative data augmentation framework for robotic manipulation that requires only a single bounding box annotation to generate diverse training scenes, eliminating the need for large-scale data collection or perfect object detection.

entry.title: Stay in Character, Stay Safe: Dual-Cycle Adversarial Self-Evolution for Safety Role-Playing Agents

author.name: Mingyang Liao, Yichen Wan, shuchen wu, Chenxi Miao, Xin Shen, Weikang Li, Yang Li, Deguo Xia, Jizhou Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free dual-cycle framework for safe LLM role-playing: one cycle generates progressively stronger jailbreak prompts, the other distills defense strategies. Addresses the tension between persona fidelity and safety in role-playing agents.

entry.title: Nanbeige4.1-3B: A Small General Model that Reasons, Aligns, and Acts

author.name: Chen Yang, Guangyue Peng, Jiaying Zhu, Ran Le, Ruixiang Feng, Tao Zhang, Xiyun Xu, Yang Song, Yiming Jia, Yuntao Wen, Yunzhi Xu, Zekai Wang, Zhenwei An, Zhicong Sun, Zongchao Chen

entry.summary: Nanbeige4.1-3B is a 3B parameter open-source model achieving strong agentic behavior, code generation, and general reasoning through combined reward modeling and RL-based training. Claims to be first SLM with such versatility.

entry.title: DiffusionRollout: Uncertainty-Aware Rollout Planning in Long-Horizon PDE Solving

author.name: Seungwoo Yoo, Juil Koo, Daehyeon Choi, Minhyuk Sung

entry.summary: DiffusionRollout uses uncertainty quantification from diffusion models to adaptively select step sizes during autoregressive PDE solving, reducing error accumulation in long-horizon predictions by choosing smaller steps when uncertainty is high.

entry.title: PhGPO: Pheromone-Guided Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Tool Planning

author.name: Yu Li, Guangfeng Cai, Shengtian Yang, Han Luo, Shuo Han, Xu He, Dong Li, Lei Feng

entry.summary: PhGPO uses pheromone-inspired mechanisms from ant colony optimization to capture reusable tool-transition patterns from historically successful trajectories, guiding long-horizon multi-step tool planning in LLM agents.

entry.title: Choosing How to Remember: Adaptive Memory Structures for LLM Agents

author.name: Mingfei Lu, Mengjia Wu, Feng Liu, Jiawei Xu, Weikai Li, Haoyang Wang, Zhengdong Hu, Ying Ding, Yizhou Sun, Jie Lu, Yi Zhang

entry.summary: FluxMem enables LLM agents to adaptively select among multiple complementary memory structures based on interaction-level features, learned through offline supervision from downstream task performance.

entry.title: Tabular Foundation Models Can Learn Association Rules

author.name: Erkan Karabulut, Daniel Daza, Paul Groth, Martijn C. Schut, Victoria Degeler

entry.summary: Shows tabular foundation models can learn association rules, introducing TabProbe as a model-agnostic framework for extracting association rules from any conditional probabilistic model over tabular data. Addresses scalability issues of classical ARM methods.

entry.title: Implicit Bias in LLMs for Transgender Populations

author.name: Micaela Hirsch, Marina Elichiry, Blas Radi, Tamara Quiroga, David Restrepo, Luciana Benotti, Veronica Xhardez, Jocelyn Dunstan, Enzo Ferrante

entry.summary: Examines implicit bias toward transgender people in LLMs using adapted word association tests and healthcare decision-making scenarios, finding persistent stereotype-driven associations despite safety training.

entry.title: A feedback control optimizer for online and hardware-aware training of Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Matteo Saponati, Chiara De Luca, Giacomo Indiveri, Benjamin Grewe

entry.summary: Presents a novel feedback control-based learning algorithm for spiking neural networks enabling on-chip supervised learning for neuromorphic hardware.

entry.title: MergePipe: A Budget-Aware Parameter Management System for Scalable LLM Merging

author.name: Yuanyi Wang, Yanggan Gu, Zihao Wang, Kunxi Li, Yifan Yang, Zhaoyi Yan, Congkai Xie, Jianmin Wu, Hongxia Yang

entry.summary: Introduces MergePipe, a parameter management system for scalable LLM merging that treats merge operations as data management problems with catalog-driven abstractions and execution lineage.

entry.title: Visual Foresight for Robotic Stow: A Diffusion-Based World Model from Sparse Snapshots

author.name: Lijun Zhang, Nikhil Chacko, Petter Nilsson, Ruinian Xu, Shantanu Thakar, Bai Lou, Harpreet Sawhney, Zhebin Zhang, Mudit Agrawal, Bhavana Chandrashekhar, Aaron Parness

entry.summary: Proposes FOREST, a stow-intent-conditioned world model using latent diffusion transformers to predict post-stow warehouse bin configurations from current observations and planned actions. Demonstrates utility in downstream robotics tasks.

entry.title: How Multimodal Large Language Models Support Access to Visual Information: A Diary Study With Blind and Low Vision People

author.name: Ricardo E. Gonzalez Penuela, Crescentia Jung, Sharon Y Lin, Ruiying Hu, Shiri Azenkot

entry.summary: Conducts a two-week diary study with 20 blind and low vision participants using MLLM-enabled visual interpretation applications, finding both benefits and limitations in real-world daily use.

entry.title: $\gamma$-weakly $\theta$-up-concavity: Linearizable Non-Convex Optimization with Applications to DR-Submodular and OSS Functions

author.name: Mohammad Pedramfar, Vaneet Aggarwal

entry.summary: Introduces gamma-weakly theta-up-concavity, a novel first-order condition that unifies DR-submodular and One-Sided Smooth functions, proving these functions are upper-linearizable for optimization.

entry.title: From What to How: Bridging User Requirements with Software Development Using Large Language Models

author.name: Xiao He, Ru Chen, Jialun Cao

entry.summary: Proposes DesBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on software design tasks including design-aware code generation, object-oriented modeling, and acceptance test case design.

entry.title: GREPO: A Benchmark for Graph Neural Networks on Repository-Level Bug Localization

author.name: Juntong Wang, Libin Chen, Xiyuan Wang, Shijia Kang, Haotong Yang, Da Zheng, Muhan Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces GREPO, the first GNN benchmark for repository-level bug localization, addressing the limitation that LLMs can't process entire code repositories due to context window constraints. Provides structured evaluation for graph-based approaches.

entry.title: Policy Gradient with Adaptive Entropy Annealing for Continual Fine-Tuning

author.name: Yaqian Zhang, Bernhard Pfahringer, Eibe Frank, Albert Bifet

entry.summary: Reformulates classification as a one-step MDP to derive Expected Policy Gradient method for continual fine-tuning, with adaptive entropy annealing to address catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning.

entry.title: GeoEyes: On-Demand Visual Focusing for Evidence-Grounded Understanding of Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Imagery

author.name: Fengxiang Wang, Mingshuo Chen, Yueying Li, Yajie Yang, Yifan Zhang, Long Lan, Xue Yang, Hongda Sun, Yulin Wang, Di Wang, Jun Song, Jing Zhang, Bo Du

entry.summary: Proposes GeoEyes for ultra-high-resolution remote sensing VQA with a staged training framework including Chain-of-Zoom dataset and AdaZoom-GRPO reinforcement learning to address tool usage homogenization in zoom-enabled MLLMs.

entry.title: Integrating Unstructured Text into Causal Inference: Empirical Evidence from Real Data

author.name: Boning Zhou, Ziyu Wang, Han Hong, Haoqi Hu

entry.summary: Presents a framework using transformer-based language models to perform causal inference from unstructured text, validating results against structured data across population, group, and individual levels.

entry.title: A Trajectory-Based Safety Audit of Clawdbot (OpenClaw)

author.name: Tianyu Chen, Dongrui Liu, Xia Hu, Jingyi Yu, Wenjie Wang

entry.summary: Trajectory-centric safety evaluation of Clawdbot (OpenClaw), a tool-using AI agent, across six risk dimensions using scenarios from prior agent-safety benchmarks plus custom cases.

entry.title: Explainable Token-level Noise Filtering for LLM Fine-tuning Datasets

author.name: Yuchen Yang, Wenze Lin, Enhao Huang, Zhixuan Chu, Hongbin Zhou, Lan Tao, Yiming Li, Zhan Qin, Kui Ren

entry.summary: Proposes XTF, a framework for token-level noise filtering in LLM fine-tuning datasets, decomposing token contributions into three explicit dimensions. Addresses the mismatch between sentence-level dataset design and token-level optimization.

entry.title: Towards Selection as Power: Bounding Decision Authority in Autonomous Agents

author.name: Jose Manuel de la Chica Rodriguez, Juan Manuel Vera D\'iaz

entry.summary: Proposes a governance architecture for autonomous agents that separates cognition, selection, and action into distinct domains, modeling autonomy as a vector of sovereignty with mechanically enforced bounds on selection and action power.

entry.title: LongAudio-RAG: Event-Grounded Question Answering over Multi-Hour Long Audio

author.name: Naveen Vakada, Kartik Hegde, Arvind Krishna Sridhar, Yinyi Guo, Erik Visser

entry.summary: Introduces LongAudio-RAG, a framework for question answering over multi-hour audio that converts audio streams into structured event records in SQL databases and uses RAG to ground LLM outputs in timestamped acoustic events.

entry.title: Picking the Right Specialist: Attentive Neural Process-based Selection of Task-Specialized Models as Tools for Agentic Healthcare Systems

author.name: Pramit Saha, Joshua Strong, Mohammad Alsharid, Divyanshu Mishra, J. Alison Noble

entry.summary: Introduces ToolSelect for agentic healthcare systems, using attentive neural processes to adaptively select the best specialist model from a pool of task-specialized tools for each query, rather than relying on a single best model.

entry.title: HBVLA: Pushing 1-Bit Post-Training Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Xin Yan, Zhenglin Wan, Feiyang Ye, Xingrui Yu, Hangyu Du, Yang You, Ivor Tsang

entry.summary: Proposes HBVLA, a binarization framework for Vision-Language-Action models that uses policy-aware Hessian analysis to identify critical weights and sparse orthogonal transforms for non-salient weights. Enables 1-bit quantization for robot deployment.

entry.title: Testing For Distribution Shifts with Conditional Conformal Test Martingales

author.name: Shalev Shaer, Yarin Bar, Drew Prinster, Yaniv Romano

entry.summary: Proposes a sequential test for distribution shifts using conditional conformal test martingales with a fixed reference set, avoiding test-time contamination that degrades existing methods. Provides anytime-valid type-I error control.

entry.title: Fast Catch-Up, Late Switching: Optimal Batch Size Scheduling via Functional Scaling Laws

author.name: Jinbo Wang, Binghui Li, Zhanpeng Zhou, Mingze Wang, Yuxuan Sun, Jiaqi Zhang, Xunliang Cai, Lei Wu

entry.summary: Analyzes batch size scheduling through functional scaling laws, showing optimal schedules depend on task difficulty: easy tasks benefit from increasing batch sizes throughout while hard tasks should maintain small batches until a late switch.

entry.title: A Critical Look at Targeted Instruction Selection: Disentangling What Matters (and What Doesn't)

author.name: Nihal V. Nayak, Paula Rodriguez-Diaz, Neha Hulkund, Sara Beery, David Alvarez-Melis

entry.summary: Systematically disentangles data representation and selection algorithm components in targeted instruction selection for LLMs. Reveals that many published improvements are due to confounded evaluations.

entry.title: Additive Control Variates Dominate Self-Normalisation in Off-Policy Evaluation

author.name: Olivier Jeunen, Shashank Gupta

entry.summary: Proves that additive control variates (β*-IPS) asymptotically dominate self-normalized IPS (SNIPS) in off-policy evaluation, analytically decomposing the variance gap.

entry.title: Graph neural networks uncover structure and functions underlying the activity of simulated neural assemblies

author.name: C\'edric Allier, Larissa Heinrich, Magdalena Schneider, Stephan Saalfeld

entry.summary: Applies graph neural networks to simulated neural assemblies with thousands of neurons, demonstrating the ability to jointly recover connectivity matrices, neuron types, signaling functions, and hidden stimuli. Offers interpretability advantages over RNNs and transformers.

entry.title: Causally constrained reduced-order neural models of complex turbulent dynamical systems

author.name: Fabrizio Falasca, Laure Zanna

entry.summary: Introduces a framework based on response theory and score matching to suppress spurious causal dependencies in reduced-order neural emulators of turbulent systems, with climate dynamics as proof-of-concept.

entry.title: Geometry-Preserving Aggregation for Mixture-of-Experts Embedding Models

author.name: Sajjad Kachuee, Mohammad Sharifkhani

entry.summary: Shows that linear aggregation in MoE embedding models distorts the hyperspherical geometry of expert outputs, and proposes Spherical Barycentric Aggregation (SBA) as a geometry-preserving alternative.

entry.title: OMGs: A multi-agent system supporting MDT decision-making across the ovarian tumour care continuum

author.name: Yangyang Zhang, Zilong Wang, Jianbo Xu, Yongqi Chen, Chu Han, Zhihao Zhang, Shuai Liu, Hui Li, Huiping Zhang, Ziqi Liu, Jiaxin Chen, Jun Zhu, Zheng Feng, Hao Wen, Xingzhu Ju, Yanping Zhong, Yunqiu Zhang, Jie Duan, Jun Li, Dongsheng Li, Weijie Wang, Haiyan Zhu, Wei Jiang, Xiaohua Wu, Shuo Wang, Haiming Li, Qinhao Guo

entry.summary: Presents OMGs, a multi-agent AI system for ovarian tumour multidisciplinary team decision support, where domain-specific agents deliberate collaboratively. Introduces SPEAR evaluation framework for MDT recommendation quality and validates across multiple clinical scenarios.

entry.title: GRRM: Group Relative Reward Modeling for Machine Translation

author.name: Sen Yang, Shanbo Cheng, Lu Xu, Jianbing Zhang, Shujian Huang

entry.summary: Introduces Group Relative Reward Model (GRRM) for machine translation that processes entire candidate groups jointly for comparative quality assessment, rather than scoring candidates in isolation. Addresses limitations of scalar quality metrics in GRPO-based post-training.

entry.title: Optimizing Point-of-Care Ultrasound Video Acquisition for Probabilistic Multi-Task Heart Failure Detection

author.name: Armin Saadat, Nima Hashemi, Bahar Khodabakhshian, Michael Y. Tsang, Christina Luong, Teresa S. M. Tsang, Purang Abolmaesumi

entry.summary: Uses reinforcement learning to optimize point-of-care ultrasound acquisition for heart failure assessment, with an RL agent selecting which views to acquire and when to stop. Jointly predicts aortic stenosis and ejection fraction with uncertainty.

entry.title: Gaussian Sequences with Multi-Scale Dynamics for 4D Reconstruction from Monocular Casual Videos

author.name: Can Li, Jie Gu, Jingmin Chen, Fangzhou Qiu, Lei Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Gaussian sequences with multi-scale dynamics for 4D reconstruction from monocular casual videos, factorizing complex motion fields from object to particle level for physically plausible dynamics.

entry.title: Train Short, Inference Long: Training-free Horizon Extension for Autoregressive Video Generation

author.name: Jia Li, Xiaomeng Fu, Xurui Peng, Weifeng Chen, Youwei Zheng, Tianyu Zhao, Jiexi Wang, Fangmin Chen, Xing Wang, Hayden Kwok-Hay So

entry.summary: Proposes FLEX, a training-free framework that bridges short-term training and long-term inference in autoregressive video diffusion, addressing spectral bias and lack of dynamic priors in noise sampling.

entry.title: ForgeryVCR: Visual-Centric Reasoning via Efficient Forensic Tools in MLLMs for Image Forgery Detection and Localization

author.name: Youqi Wang, Shen Chen, Haowei Wang, Rongxuan Peng, Taiping Yao, Shunquan Tan, Changsheng Chen, Bin Li, Shouhong Ding

entry.summary: Proposes ForgeryVCR for image forgery detection using visual-centric reasoning with a forensic toolbox, shifting from text-centric CoT to visual intermediates to avoid hallucinations in characterizing pixel-level tampering.

entry.title: Learning Proposes, Geometry Disposes: A Modular Framework for Efficient Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Haichao Zhu, Zhaorui Yang, Qian Zhang

entry.summary: Investigates a modular framework for spatial reasoning where learning proposes geometric hypotheses and geometric algorithms dispose/select solutions, comparing against end-to-end replacement approaches.

entry.title: DriveFine: Refining-Augmented Masked Diffusion VLA for Precise and Robust Driving

author.name: Chenxu Dang, Sining Ang, Yongkang Li, Haochen Tian, Jie Wang, Guang Li, Hangjun Ye, Jie Ma, Long Chen, Yan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DriveFine, a masked diffusion VLA model for autonomous driving that combines flexible decoding with self-correction via a plug-and-play block-MoE architecture adding refinement experts.

entry.title: Universal Image Immunization against Diffusion-based Image Editing via Semantic Injection

author.name: Chanhui Lee, Seunghyun Shin, Donggyu Choi, Hae-gon Jeon, Jeany Son

entry.summary: Proposes the first universal image immunization framework generating a single adversarial perturbation to defend against diffusion-based semantic image editing, eliminating per-image optimization.

entry.title: SAILS: Segment Anything with Incrementally Learned Semantics for Task-Invariant and Training-Free Continual Learning

author.name: Shishir Muralidhara, Didier Stricker, Ren\'e Schuster

entry.summary: Presents SAILS, a training-free framework for class-incremental semantic segmentation that uses SAM for zero-shot region extraction and semantic association through prototypes, completely avoiding retraining.

entry.title: A Kung Fu Athlete Bot That Can Do It All Day: Highly Dynamic, Balance-Challenging Motion Dataset and Autonomous Fall-Resilient Tracking

author.name: Zhongxiang Lei, Lulu Cao, Xuyang Wang, Tianyi Qian, Jinyan Liu, Xuesong Li

entry.summary: Presents KungFuAthlete, a high-dynamic martial arts motion dataset from professional athletes, and develops a fall-resilient tracking system for humanoid robots that can recover from balance-challenging motions.

entry.title: The More the Merrier: Running Multiple Neuromorphic Components On-Chip for Robotic Control

author.name: Evan Eames, Priyadarshini Kannan, Ronan Sangouard, Philipp Plank, Elvin Hajizada, Gintautas Palinauskas, Lana Amaya, Michael Neumeier, Sai Thejeshwar Sharma, Marcella Toth, Prottush Sarkar, Axel von Arnim

entry.summary: Demonstrates running multiple neuromorphic components entirely on-chip for vision-based robot control using Intel Loihi 2, with a spiking neural state machine for process orchestration rather than off-chip management.

entry.title: Multimodal Covariance Steering in Belief Space with Active Probing and Influence for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Devodita Chakravarty, John Dolan, Yiwei Lyu

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical belief model for autonomous driving that structures human behavior across discrete intents and continuous motion modes, enabling both estimation and active shaping of human behavior when ambiguity poses risks.

entry.title: Affordance Transfer Across Object Instances via Semantically Anchored Functional Map

author.name: Xiaoxiang Dong, Weiming Zhi

entry.summary: SemFM uses Semantic Anchored Functional Maps to transfer affordances across object instances from a single visual demonstration, enabling generalization across objects with different geometries but similar functionality.

entry.title: BotzoneBench: Scalable LLM Evaluation via Graded AI Anchors

author.name: Lingfeng Li, Yunlong Lu, Yuefei Zhang, Jingyu Yao, Yixin Zhu, KeYuan Cheng, Yongyi Wang, Qirui Zheng, Xionghui Yang, Wenxin Li

entry.summary: Introduces BotzoneBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM strategic reasoning using graded AI anchors rather than LLM-vs-LLM tournaments, addressing scalability and stability issues in game-based evaluations. Avoids quadratic costs of pairwise tournaments.

entry.title: AST-PAC: AST-guided Membership Inference for Code

author.name: Roham Koohestani, Ali Al-Kaswan, Jonathan Katzy, Maliheh Izadi

entry.summary: AST-PAC improves membership inference attacks for code LLMs by incorporating Abstract Syntax Tree structure into augmentation strategies, respecting code's rigid syntax. Evaluates on 3B-7B parameter code models.

entry.title: MoralityGym: A Benchmark for Evaluating Hierarchical Moral Alignment in Sequential Decision-Making Agents

author.name: Simon Rosen, Siddarth Singh, Ebenezer Gelo, Helen Sarah Robertson, Ibrahim Suder, Victoria Williams, Benjamin Rosman, Geraud Nangue Tasse, Steven James

entry.summary: Introduces Morality Chains for representing moral norms as ordered deontic constraints and MoralityGym benchmark with 98 ethical dilemma problems as Gymnasium environments. Baseline Safe RL methods reveal key limitations.

entry.title: Building Autonomous GUI Navigation via Agentic-Q Estimation and Step-Wise Policy Optimization

author.name: Yibo Wang, Guangda Huzhang, Yuwei Hu, Yu Xia, Shiyin Lu, Qing-Guo Chen, Zhao Xu, Weihua Luo, Kaifu Zhang, Lijun Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces agentic-Q estimation for GUI agents that generates step-wise values to evaluate action contributions to task completion, combined with step-wise policy optimization for non-stationary GUI environments.

entry.title: MATEO: A Multimodal Benchmark for Temporal Reasoning and Planning in LVLMs

author.name: Gabriel Roccabruna, Olha Khomyn, Giuseppe Riccardi

entry.summary: Introduces MATEO, a multimodal benchmark for temporal reasoning and planning in vision-language models, focusing on temporal execution order as directed acyclic graphs rather than simple linear chains.

entry.title: MAC-AMP: A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Collaboration System for Multi-Objective Antimicrobial Peptide Design

author.name: Gen Zhou, Sugitha Janarthanan, Lianghong Chen, Pingzhao Hu

entry.summary: Introduces MAC-AMP, a closed-loop multi-agent LLM collaboration system for designing antimicrobial peptides that balances activity, toxicity, and novelty objectives.

entry.title: PeroMAS: A Multi-agent System of Perovskite Material Discovery

author.name: Yishu Wang, Wei Liu, Yifan Li, Shengxiang Xu, Xujie Yuan, Ran Li, Yuyu Luo, Jia Zhu, Shimin Di, Min-Ling Zhang, Guixiang Li

entry.summary: Introduces PeroMAS, a multi-agent system for perovskite solar cell material discovery that integrates literature retrieval, data integration, experimental design, and synthesis into a unified workflow. Addresses the limitation of existing discrete AI models that fail to propagate physical constraints across the pipeline.

entry.title: Nonparametric Distribution Regression Re-calibration

author.name: \'Ad\'am Jung, Domokos M. Kelen, Andr\'as A. Bencz\'ur

entry.summary: Proposes a nonparametric re-calibration algorithm for probabilistic regression that addresses limitations of existing post-hoc calibration methods that rely on weak calibration notions or restrictive parametric assumptions.

entry.title: LLM-Powered Automatic Translation and Urgency in Crisis Scenarios

author.name: Belu Ticona, Antonis Anastasopoulos

entry.summary: Examines LLM and MT system performance in crisis-domain translation, showing both exhibit substantial degradation in preserving urgency. Introduces an urgency-annotated multilingual dataset covering 32+ languages.

entry.title: Anthropomorphism on Risk Perception: The Role of Trust and Domain Knowledge in Decision-Support AI

author.name: Manuele Reani, Xiangyang He, Zuolan Bao

entry.summary: Studies how anthropomorphic AI design affects risk perception through trust, finding that anthropomorphism reduces risk perception by increasing both cognitive and affective trust, moderated by domain knowledge. Large-scale experiment with N=1,256.

entry.title: PT-RAG: Structure-Fidelity Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Academic Papers

author.name: Rui Yu, Tianyi Wang, Ruixia Liu, Yinglong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PT-RAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework that preserves the native hierarchical structure of academic papers as a retrieval prior, improving evidence allocation under fixed token budgets.

entry.title: On the Sparsifiability of Correlation Clustering: Approximation Guarantees under Edge Sampling

author.name: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Sanjeda Akter, Anuj Sharma

entry.summary: Studies sparsification-approximation trade-offs for correlation clustering, proving the VC dimension is exactly n-1 and establishing a structural dichotomy between pseudometric and general weighted instances.

entry.title: DTBench: A Synthetic Benchmark for Document-to-Table Extraction

author.name: Yuxiang Guo, Zhuoran Du, Nan Tang, Kezheng Tang, Congcong Ge, Yunjun Gao

entry.summary: Introduces DTBench, a synthetic benchmark for document-to-table extraction that distinguishes direct and indirect extraction capabilities, providing capability-aware evaluation of LLMs for structured information extraction.

entry.title: The Sufficiency-Conciseness Trade-off in LLM Self-Explanation from an Information Bottleneck Perspective

author.name: Ali Zahedzadeh, Behnam Bahrak

entry.summary: Examines the trade-off between sufficiency and conciseness in LLM chain-of-thought self-explanations through an information bottleneck lens, introducing an evaluation pipeline to measure how much explanation is truly necessary.

entry.title: TabTracer: Monte Carlo Tree Search for Complex Table Reasoning with Large Language Models

author.name: Zhizhao Luo, Zhaojing Luo, Meihui Zhang, Rui Mao

entry.summary: Proposes TabTracer, an MCTS-based agentic framework for complex table reasoning that coordinates multi-step tool calls with explicit state tracking for verification and rollback, reducing token costs vs. chain/beam approaches.

entry.title: When Test-Time Guidance Is Enough: Fast Image and Video Editing with Diffusion Guidance

author.name: Ahmed Ghorbel, Badr Moufad, Navid Bagheri Shouraki, Alain Oliviero Durmus, Thomas Hirtz, Eric Moulines, Jimmy Olsson, Yazid Janati

entry.summary: Extends VJP-free test-time guidance for diffusion/flow models to large-scale image and video editing, demonstrating competitive results without costly vector-Jacobian product computations.

entry.title: Dual-Signal Adaptive KV-Cache Optimization for Long-Form Video Understanding in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Vishnu Sai, Dheeraj Sai, Srinath B, Girish Varma, Priyesh Shukla

entry.summary: Proposes Sali-Cache, a dual-signal adaptive KV-cache optimization for long-form video understanding in VLMs, combining temporal optical flow filtering with spatial saliency detection for proactive memory management.

entry.title: WIMLE: Uncertainty-Aware World Models with IMLE for Sample-Efficient Continuous Control

author.name: Mehran Aghabozorgi, Alireza Moazeni, Yanshu Zhang, Ke Li

entry.summary: Introduces WIMLE, a model-based RL method using IMLE for learning multi-modal world models with uncertainty estimation, weighting synthetic transitions by predicted confidence for stable learning.

entry.title: Adapting VACE for Real-Time Autoregressive Video Diffusion

author.name: Ryan Fosdick (Daydream)

entry.summary: Adapts VACE (Video All-in-one Creation and Editing) for real-time autoregressive video generation by moving reference frames to a parallel conditioning pathway, maintaining compatibility with streaming pipelines at 1.3B and 14B scales.

entry.title: Selective Synchronization Attention

author.name: Hasi Hays

entry.summary: Proposes Selective Synchronization Attention (SSA), replacing dot-product self-attention with a mechanism derived from the Kuramoto model of coupled oscillators, where tokens are oscillators with learnable frequencies and phases. Claims sub-quadratic complexity and biological grounding.

entry.title: OPBench: A Graph Benchmark to Combat the Opioid Crisis

author.name: Tianyi Ma, Yiyang Li, Yiyue Qian, Zheyuan Zhang, Zehong Wang, Chuxu Zhang, Yanfang Ye

entry.summary: Introduces OPBench, the first comprehensive graph learning benchmark for opioid crisis applications, covering overdose detection, drug trafficking detection, and drug misuse prediction across five datasets.

entry.title: VariViT: A Vision Transformer for Variable Image Sizes

author.name: Aswathi Varma, Suprosanna Shit, Chinmay Prabhakar, Daniel Scholz, Hongwei Bran Li, Bjoern Menze, Daniel Rueckert, Benedikt Wiestler

entry.summary: Proposes VariViT, a Vision Transformer that handles variable-sized input images without resizing, padding, or cropping, particularly useful for medical imaging where irregular structures like tumors need tailored crops.

entry.title: ST-EVO: Towards Generative Spatio-Temporal Evolution of Multi-Agent Communication Topologies

author.name: Xingjian Wu, Xvyuan Liu, Junkai Lu, Siyuan Wang, Yang Shu, Jilin Hu, Chenjuan Guo, Bin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes ST-EVO for spatio-temporal evolution of communication topologies in LLM-powered multi-agent systems, supporting dialogue-wise scheduling with compact graph-based representations rather than static templates.

entry.title: On Representation Redundancy in Large-Scale Instruction Tuning Data Selection

author.name: Youwei Shu, Shaomian Zheng, Dingnan Jin, Wenjie Qu, Ziyao Guo, Qing Cui, Jun Zhou, Jiaheng Zhang

entry.summary: Studies instruction-tuning data selection through semantic representation similarity and identifies redundancy in LLM encoder embeddings. Proposes CRDS framework using random projection and autoencoder variants to mitigate embedding redundancy.

entry.title: sleep2vec: Unified Cross-Modal Alignment for Heterogeneous Nocturnal Biosignals

author.name: Weixuan Yuan, Zengrui Jin, Yichen Wang, Donglin Xie, Ziyi Ye, Chao Zhang, Xuesong Chen

entry.summary: Presents sleep2vec, a foundation model for diverse nocturnal biosignals that learns shared representations via cross-modal alignment across 9 modalities from 42K recordings. Handles heterogeneous devices and sensor dropout.

entry.title: ROAST: Rollout-based On-distribution Activation Steering Technique

author.name: Xuanbo Su, Hao Luo, Yingfang Zhang, Lijun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ROAST, an activation steering method for LLMs that uses the model's own on-distribution rollouts and continuous soft scaling instead of discrete masking, avoiding off-distribution supervision.

entry.title: One Good Source is All You Need: Near-Optimal Regret for Bandits under Heterogeneous Noise

author.name: Aadirupa Saha, Amith Bhat, Haipeng Luo

entry.summary: Studies multi-armed bandits with heterogeneous data sources of unknown noise variances. Proposes SOAR algorithm that prunes high-variance sources and identifies both the best arm and optimal data source, achieving near-optimal regret.

entry.title: An Embarrassingly Simple Way to Optimize Orthogonal Matrices at Scale

author.name: Adri\'an Javaloy, Antonio Vergari

entry.summary: Introduces POGO, a GPU-friendly algorithm for optimizing orthogonal matrices at scale using only 5 matrix products. Improves on the Landing algorithm while ensuring orthogonal constraints are met, scaling to hundreds of constraints.

entry.title: Locally Adaptive Multi-Objective Learning

author.name: Jivat Neet Kaur, Isaac Gibbs, Michael I. Jordan

entry.summary: Studies online multi-objective learning with locally adaptive guarantees over contiguous subintervals, providing empirical evaluation that was missing from prior theoretical work. Authors include Michael I. Jordan.

entry.title: PDE foundation models are skillful AI weather emulators for the Martian atmosphere

author.name: Johannes Schmude, Sujit Roy, Liping Wang, Theodore van Kessel, Levente Klein, Marcus Freitag, Eloisa Bentivegna, Robert Manson-Sawko, Bjorn Lutjens, Manil Maskey, Campbell Watson, Rahul Ramachandran, Juan Bernabe-Moreno

entry.summary: Demonstrates that PDE foundation models pretrained on diverse partial differential equations can be adapted for Martian weather prediction, extending the Poseidon model from 2D to 3D while retaining pretraining benefits. Achieves 34% performance improvement with only 13 GPU hours of training.

entry.title: VAR-3D: View-aware Auto-Regressive Model for Text-to-3D Generation via a 3D Tokenizer

author.name: Zongcheng Han, Dongyan Cao, Haoran Sun, Yu Hong

entry.summary: Proposes VAR-3D, a view-aware auto-regressive model for text-to-3D generation using a novel 3D tokenizer that reduces information loss during encoding and addresses the objective mismatch between reconstruction and generation stages.

entry.title: AdaptManip: Learning Adaptive Whole-Body Object Lifting and Delivery with Online Recurrent State Estimation

author.name: Morgan Byrd, Donghoon Baek, Kartik Garg, Hyunyoung Jung, Daesol Cho, Maks Sorokin, Robert Wright, Sehoon Ha

entry.summary: Proposes AdaptManip, an autonomous framework for humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation using RL without human demonstrations, combining recurrent object state estimation with whole-body control for object lifting and delivery.

entry.title: CAIRO: Decoupling Order from Scale in Regression

author.name: Harri Vanhems, Yue Zhao, Peng Shi, Archer Y. Yang

entry.summary: Proposes CAIRO, decoupling regression into ranking (scale-invariant) and scale recovery (isotonic regression) stages. Proves that 'Optimal-in-Rank-Order' objectives recover the ordering of conditional means under mild assumptions.

entry.title: Drift-Diffusion Matching: Embedding dynamics in latent manifolds of asymmetric neural networks

author.name: Ram\'on Nartallo-Kaluarachchi, Renaud Lambiotte, Alain Goriely

entry.summary: Introduces drift-diffusion matching for training continuous-time RNNs with asymmetric connectivity to represent arbitrary stochastic dynamical systems in low-dimensional latent spaces, extending beyond Hopfield-like symmetric networks.

entry.title: Speculative Decoding with a Speculative Vocabulary

author.name: Miles Williams, Young D. Kwon, Rui Li, Alexandros Kouris, Stylianos I. Venieris
