entry.title: Learning Structural Hardness for Combinatorial Auctions: Instance-Dependent Algorithm Selection via Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Sungwoo Kang

entry.summary: Trains a lightweight MLP to predict when combinatorial auction instances are hard for greedy heuristics, enabling instance-dependent algorithm selection rather than trying to replace solvers with ML.

entry.title: Extending Multi-Source Bayesian Optimization With Causality Principles

author.name: Luuk Jacobs, Mohammad Ali Javidian

entry.summary: Extends multi-source Bayesian optimization with causal principles, enabling the framework to leverage causal graphs and interventional knowledge across multiple information sources.

entry.title: Expected Moral Shortfall for Ethical Competence in Decision-making Models

author.name: Aisha Aijaz, Raghava Mutharaju, Manohar Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces Expected Moral Shortfall (EMS), a mathematical framework for quantifying ethical competence in AI decision-making models, analogous to financial risk metrics. Compares techniques for instilling ethical competence across multiple performance metrics.

entry.title: NeuroMambaLLM: Dynamic Graph Learning of fMRI Functional Connectivity in Autistic Brains Using Mamba and Language Model Reasoning

author.name: Yasaman Torabi, Parsa Razmara, Hamed Ajorlou, Bardia Baraeinejad

entry.summary: Proposes NeuroMambaLLM, combining dynamic latent graph learning with Mamba state-space models and LLM reasoning for fMRI-based autism classification. Integrates brain connectivity analysis with language model reasoning.

entry.title: Evolving Multi-Channel Confidence-Aware Activation Functions for Missing Data with Channel Propagation

author.name: Naeem Shahabi Sani, Ferial Najiantabriz, Shayan Shafaei, Dean F. Hougen

entry.summary: Proposes Three-Channel Evolved Activations (3C-EA) using genetic programming to create activation functions that take feature values, missingness indicators, and confidence scores, with a channel propagation mechanism for deeper layers.

entry.title: Exploring the limits of pre-trained embeddings in machine-guided protein design: a case study on predicting AAV vector viability

author.name: Ana F. Rodrigues, Lucas Ferraz, Laura Balbi, Pedro Giesteira Cotovio, Catia Pesquita

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates pre-trained protein sequence embeddings for predicting AAV vector viability, finding that sequence-level representations struggle with sparse mutation patterns typical of bioengineering.

entry.title: NutVLM: A Self-Adaptive Defense Framework against Full-Dimension Attacks for Vision Language Models in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Xiaoxu Peng, Dong Zhou, Jianwen Zhang, Guanghui Sun, Anh Tu Ngo, Anupam Chattopadhyay

entry.summary: Proposes NutVLM, a self-adaptive defense framework for vision-language models in autonomous driving that handles both local patches and global perturbations through a unified detection-purification mechanism.

entry.title: MotionWeaver: Holistic 4D-Anchored Framework for Multi-Humanoid Image Animation

author.name: Xirui Hu, Yanbo Ding, Jiahao Wang, Tingting Shi, Yali Wang, Guo Zhi Zhi, Weizhan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MotionWeaver for multi-humanoid image animation using unified motion representations with 4D-anchored spatial reasoning, addressing the challenges of diverse humanoid forms, complex interactions, and occlusions.

entry.title: Explore Intrinsic Geometry for Query-based Tiny and Oriented Object Detector with Momentum-based Bipartite Matching

author.name: Junpeng Zhang, Zewei Yang, Jie Feng, Yuhui Zheng, Ronghua Shang, Mengxuan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes IGOFormer for query-based oriented object detection that integrates intrinsic geometry into feature decoding and uses momentum-based bipartite matching for inter-stage consistency. Targets tiny and oriented objects.

entry.title: ARport: An Augmented Reality System for Markerless Image-Guided Port Placement in Robotic Surgery

author.name: Zheng Han, Zixin Yang, Yonghao Long, Lin Zhang, Peter Kazanzides, Qi Dou

entry.summary: Presents ARport, a markerless augmented reality system for surgical port placement that maps pre-planned trocar layouts onto the patient using only an optical see-through HMD without external sensors.

entry.title: Differential pose optimization in descriptor space -- Combining Geometric and Photometric Methods for Motion Estimation

author.name: Andreas L. Teigen, Annette Stahl, Rudolf Mester

entry.summary: Proposes combining geometric and photometric methods for two-frame relative pose optimization using dense descriptor residuals instead of photometric error, enabling sub-pixel accuracy with geometric features.

entry.title: Hierarchical Vision-Language Interaction for Facial Action Unit Detection

author.name: Yong Li, Yi Ren, Yizhe Zhang, Wenhua Zhang, Tianyi Zhang, Muyun Jiang, Guo-Sen Xie, Cuntai Guan

entry.summary: Proposes HiVA for facial action unit detection using hierarchical vision-language interaction with LLM-generated AU descriptions as semantic priors to guide detection under limited data.

entry.title: Efficient Text-Guided Convolutional Adapter for the Diffusion Model

author.name: Aryan Das, Koushik Biswas, Swalpa Kumar Roy, Badri Narayana Patro, Vinay Kumar Verma

entry.summary: Introduces Nexus Adapters, text-guided efficient adapters for diffusion-based structure-preserving conditional generation that are prompt-aware and much more parameter-efficient than existing approaches.

entry.title: Error Patterns in Historical OCR: A Comparative Analysis of TrOCR and a Vision-Language Model

author.name: Ari Vesalainen, Eetu M\"akel\"a, Laura Ruotsalainen, Mikko Tolonen

entry.summary: Compares TrOCR and a vision-language model (Qwen) for historical OCR, finding VLMs achieve lower error rates but exhibit linguistic regularization that can alter original spellings.

entry.title: Discrete Gene Crossover Accelerates Solution Discovery in Quality-Diversity Algorithms

author.name: Joshua Hutchinson, J. Michael Herrmann, Sim\'on C. Smith

entry.summary: Proposes a mutation operator for Quality-Diversity algorithms that augments variation-based operators with discrete gene-level crossover, inspired by biological meiosis. This enables rapid recombination of elite genetic material across large populations.

entry.title: High-Fidelity, Customizable Force Sensing for the Wearable Human-Robot Interface

author.name: Noah Rubin, Ava Schraeder, Hrishikesh Sahu, Thomas C. Bulea, Lillian Chin

entry.summary: Presents a 3D-printed silicone force-sensing pad with embedded air channels for measuring forces at the human-robot wearable interface, achieving R²=0.998 linearity between pad pressure and applied force.

entry.title: ONRAP: Occupancy-driven Noise-Resilient Autonomous Path Planning

author.name: Faizan M. Tariq, Avinash Singh, Vipul Ramtekkar, Jovin D'sa, David Isele, Yosuke Sakamoto, Sangjae Bae

entry.summary: ONRAP is a path planner operating on occupancy grids with optional occupancy-flow predictions, using a nonlinear program based on a modified bicycle model. Runs in real-time (>10 Hz) and handles unknown obstacle classes.

entry.title: XIT: Exploration and Exploitation Informed Trees for Active Gas Distribution Mapping in Unknown Environments

author.name: Mal Fazliu, Matthew Coombes, Sen Wang, Cunjia Liu

entry.summary: XIT (Exploration-Exploitation Informed Trees) is a sampling-based planner for autonomous gas distribution mapping that balances exploring unknown space with exploiting gas distribution beliefs, formulated as a next-best-trajectory informative path planning problem.

entry.title: Modeling and Optimizing the Provisioning of Exhaustible Capabilities for Simultaneous Task Allocation and Scheduling

author.name: Jinwoo Park, Harish Ravichandar, Seth Hutchinson

entry.summary: TRAITS is a multi-robot task allocation framework handling exhaustible traits (depleting capabilities) under battery and temporal constraints, using nonlinear programming for trait distribution optimization across heterogeneous robot teams.

entry.title: RoboSolver: A Multi-Agent Large Language Model Framework for Solving Robotic Arm Problems

author.name: Hamid Khabazi, Ali F. Meghdari, Alireza Taheri

entry.summary: RoboSolver is a multi-agent LLM/VLM framework for automatically solving robotic arm problems - performing kinematics, computing velocities, generating 3D simulations, and executing motion control from text/visual inputs.

entry.title: ROSA: Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction in Multimodal Traffic

author.name: Anna-Lena Schlamp, Jeremias Gerner, Klaus Bogenberger, Werner Huber, Stefanie Schmidtner

entry.summary: ROSA combines multi-agent trajectory prediction (Transformer-based) with coordinated speed guidance for mixed traffic at roundabouts, achieving 1.29m ADE at 5-second horizon, with improvements when route intention is available.

entry.title: Mixture-of-experts Wishart model for covariance matrices with an application to Cancer drug screening

author.name: The Tien Mai, Zhi Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces a mixture-of-experts Wishart model where Wishart mixture weights depend on predictors through multinomial logistic gating, enabling modeling of heterogeneous covariance structures with covariate-dependent cluster membership.

entry.title: MacNet: An End-to-End Manifold-Constrained Adaptive Clustering Network for Interpretable Whole Slide Image Classification

author.name: Mingrui Ma, Chentao Li, Pan Huang, Jing Qin

entry.summary: Proposes MacNet, an end-to-end MIL framework for WSI classification using Grassmann re-embedding and manifold adaptive clustering for interpretable pathological diagnosis.

entry.title: Freq-DP Net: A Dual-Branch Network for Fence Removal using Dual-Pixel and Fourier Priors

author.name: Kunal Swami, Sudha Velusamy, Chandra Sekhar Seelamantula

entry.summary: Proposes Freq-DP Net, the first framework to leverage dual-pixel sensors for fence removal, combining defocus disparity and structural priors via Fast Fourier Convolution.

entry.title: OmniVTON++: Training-Free Universal Virtual Try-On with Principal Pose Guidance

author.name: Zhaotong Yang, Yong Du, Shengfeng He, Yuhui Li, Xinzhe Li, Yangyang Xu, Junyu Dong, Jian Yang

entry.summary: Presents OmniVTON++, a training-free virtual try-on framework with Principal Pose Guidance for universal applicability across different garment types and body poses.

entry.title: MeFEm: Medical Face Embedding model

author.name: Yury Borets, Stepan Botman

entry.summary: Presents MeFEm, a face embedding model based on modified JEPA with axial stripe masking and probabilistic CLS token reassignment, targeting biometric and medical analysis from facial images.

entry.title: Agentic AI for Commercial Insurance Underwriting with Adversarial Self-Critique

author.name: Joyjit Roy, Samaresh Kumar Singh

entry.summary: Presents an agentic AI system for commercial insurance underwriting that uses adversarial self-critique as a safety mechanism, with a critic agent challenging the primary agent's decisions. The human-in-the-loop design is practically relevant for regulated industries.

entry.title: Intelligence as Trajectory-Dominant Pareto Optimization

author.name: Truong Xuan Khanh, Truong Quynh Hoa

entry.summary: Formulates intelligence as trajectory-level multi-objective optimization, introducing 'Pareto traps' - locally non-dominated trajectory regions that restrict access to globally superior paths. Offers a theoretical framework for understanding stagnation in long-horizon AI.

entry.title: Situation Graph Prediction: Structured Perspective Inference for User Modeling

author.name: Jisung Shin, Daniel Platnick, Marjan Alirezaie, Hossein Rahnama

entry.summary: Proposes Situation Graph Prediction (SGP) for modeling user perspectives as structured, ontology-aligned representations, using synthetic data generation and retrieval-augmented in-context learning. Addresses privacy issues in perspective modeling.

entry.title: Detecting Jailbreak Attempts in Clinical Training LLMs Through Automated Linguistic Feature Extraction

author.name: Tri Nguyen, Huy Hoang Bao Le, Lohith Srikanth Pentapalli, Laurah Turner, Kelly Cohen

entry.summary: Detects jailbreak attempts in clinical training LLMs by training BERT-based models to automatically predict linguistic features (professionalism, medical relevance, ethical behavior, contextual distraction) that were previously manually annotated.

entry.title: An end-to-end agentic pipeline for smart contract translation and quality evaluation

author.name: Abhinav Goel, Chaitya Shah, Agostino Capponi, Alfio Gliozzo

entry.summary: End-to-end pipeline for translating natural language contractual specifications into Solidity smart contracts, with automated quality assessment across five dimensions including functional completeness and business-logic fidelity.

entry.title: Experimentation Accelerator: Interpretable Insights and Creative Recommendations for A/B Testing with Content-Aware ranking

author.name: Zhengmian Hu, Lei Shi, Ritwik Sinha, Justin Grover, David Arbour

entry.summary: Framework for A/B testing that prioritizes which variants to test, explains why winners win, and suggests new higher-potential variants by leveraging treatment embeddings and historical outcomes with content-aware ranking.

entry.title: GREAT-EER: Graph Edge Attention Network for Emergency Evacuation Responses

author.name: Attila Lischka, Bal\'azs Kulcs\'ar

entry.summary: Proposes GREAT-EER, a deep RL-based graph edge attention network for bus evacuation routing optimization (BEOP), addressing NP-hard combinatorial optimization for emergency evacuations.

entry.title: Removing Planner Bias in Goal Recognition Through Multi-Plan Dataset Generation

author.name: Mustafa F. Abdelwahed, Felipe Meneguzzi Kin Max Piamolini Gusmao, Joan Espasa

entry.summary: Addresses planner bias in goal recognition datasets by using top-k planning to generate multiple plans per goal hypothesis, creating more challenging and realistic benchmarks.

entry.title: Lifted Relational Probabilistic Inference via Implicit Learning

author.name: Luise Ge, Brendan Juba, Kris Nilsson, Alison Shao

entry.summary: Studies answering queries in first-order relational probabilistic logic through implicit learning without constructing explicit models, merging incomplete first-order axioms with independently sampled data.

entry.title: Judging the Judges: Human Validation of Multi-LLM Evaluation for High-Quality K--12 Science Instructional Materials

author.name: Peng He, Zhaohui Li, Zeyuan Wang, Jinjun Xiong, Tingting Li

entry.summary: Examines how human experts evaluate AI-generated assessments of K-12 science instructional materials, using GPT-4o, Claude, and Gemini to evaluate curriculum units against the EQuIP rubric.

entry.title: Explanatory Interactive Machine Learning for Bias Mitigation in Visual Gender Classification

author.name: Nathanya Satriani, Djordje Slijep\v{c}evi\'c, Markus Schedl, Matthias Zeppelzauer

entry.summary: Explores explanatory interactive learning (XIL) for bias mitigation in visual gender classification, comparing CAIPI, Right for the Right Reasons, and a hybrid approach.

entry.title: Semantic Waveforms for AI-Native 6G Networks

author.name: Nour Hello, Mohamed Amine Hamoura, Francois Rivet, Emilio Calvanese Strinati

entry.summary: Proposes OSSDM, a semantic-aware waveform design framework for AI-native 6G networks that jointly optimizes physical layer resources and semantic communication efficiency while accounting for RF hardware constraints.

entry.title: From Perceptions To Evidence: Detecting AI-Generated Content In Turkish News Media With A Fine-Tuned Bert Classifier

author.name: Ozancan Ozdemir

entry.summary: Fine-tunes a Turkish BERT model to detect AI-generated content in Turkish news media, achieving 0.97 F1 score. First empirical study of AI-generated content prevalence in Turkish outlets.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Sensing and Fusion in mmWave Beamforming for Connected Vehicles: A Transformer Based Framework

author.name: Muhammad Baqer Mollah, Honggang Wang, Mohammad Ataul Karim, Hua Fang

entry.summary: Proposes a transformer-based multi-modal sensing and fusion framework for mmWave beamforming in connected vehicles, combining features from multiple sensor modalities to reduce beam training overhead.

entry.title: Restoration Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation on Low Quality Images

author.name: Kai Guan, Rongyuan Wu, Shuai Li, Wentao Zhu, Wenjun Zeng, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes RASS for adapting image restoration models to improve semantic segmentation on low-quality images, bridging the gap between pixel-level restoration and task-relevant semantic recovery.

entry.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Medical AI: Leveraging Fine-Tuned GPT, LLaMA, and DeepSeek R1 for Evidence-Based and Bias-Aware Clinical Query Processing

author.name: Naeimeh Nourmohammadi, Md Meem Hossain, The Anh Han, Safina Showkat Ara, Zia Ush Shamszaman

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent medical QA framework combining fine-tuned GPT, LLaMA, and DeepSeek R1 with evidence retrieval, uncertainty estimation, and bias checks. DeepSeek R1 achieves strongest individual scores.

entry.title: BHyGNN+: Unsupervised Representation Learning for Heterophilic Hypergraphs

author.name: Tianyi Ma, Yiyue Qian, Zehong Wang, Zheyuan Zhang, Chuxu Zhang, Yanfang Ye

entry.summary: Introduces BHyGNN+, a self-supervised learning framework for heterophilic hypergraphs that extends prior work BHyGNN to work without labels, addressing the limitation of label-dependent methods.

entry.title: Spectral Convolution on Orbifolds for Geometric Deep Learning

author.name: Tim Mangliers, Bernhard M\"ossner, Benjamin Himpel

entry.summary: Introduces spectral convolution on orbifolds as a building block for geometric deep learning on orbifold-structured data, extending GDL beyond standard manifolds and graphs.

entry.title: Fast Swap-Based Element Selection for Multiplication-Free Dimension Reduction

author.name: Nobutaka Ono

entry.summary: Proposes a fast algorithm for element selection as multiplication-free dimension reduction, where reduced vectors are simply subsets of input elements, suitable for resource-constrained systems.

entry.title: Physics Aware Neural Networks: Denoising for Magnetic Navigation

author.name: Aritra Das (Ashoka University), Yashas Shende (Ashoka University), Muskaan Chugh (Ashoka University), Reva Laxmi Chauhan (Ashoka University), Arghya Pathak (Ashoka University), Debayan Gupta (Ashoka University)

entry.summary: Proposes physics-aware neural networks for magnetic navigation denoising that enforce divergence-free and E(3)-equivariance constraints from Maxwell's equations. Targets the practical problem of extracting geomagnetic signals from aircraft-induced noise.

entry.title: S2SServiceBench: A Multimodal Benchmark for Last-Mile S2S Climate Services

author.name: Chenyue Li, Wen Deng, Zhuotao Sun, Mengxi Jin, Hanzhe Cui, Han Li, Shentong Li, Man Kit Yu, Ming Long Lai, Yuhao Yang, Mengqian Lu, Binhang Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces S2SServiceBench, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating whether MLLMs can translate subseasonal-to-seasonal climate forecasts into actionable decision-making deliverables.

entry.title: In Transformer We Trust? A Perspective on Transformer Architecture Failure Modes

author.name: Trishit Mondal, Ameya D. Jagtap

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive review of transformer architecture failure modes across domains including healthcare, autonomous systems, and scientific computing. Examines interpretability, robustness, and trustworthiness concerns.

entry.title: Alignment Adapter to Improve the Performance of Compressed Deep Learning Models

author.name: Rohit Raj Rai, Abhishek Dhaka, Amit Awekar

entry.summary: Proposes Alignment Adapter (AlAd), a lightweight sliding-window adapter that aligns compressed model embeddings with original large model embeddings. Works as plug-and-play module agnostic to compression method.

entry.title: Ask the Expert: Collaborative Inference for Vision Transformers with Near-Edge Accelerators

author.name: Hao Liu, Suhaib A. Fahmy

entry.summary: Proposes a collaborative inference framework for Vision Transformers that routes low-confidence samples from a lightweight edge model to specialized experts on a near-edge accelerator, using Top-k predictions for dynamic routing.

entry.title: Ensemble-Conditional Gaussian Processes (Ens-CGP): Representation, Geometry, and Inference

author.name: Sai Ravela, Jae Deok Kim, Kenneth Gee, Xingjian Yan, Samson Mercier, Lubna Albarghouty, Anamitra Saha

entry.summary: Formulates Ensemble-Conditional Gaussian Processes (Ens-CGP) as a unifying framework connecting Kalman filtering, ensemble methods, and conditional Gaussian processes for probabilistic inference.

entry.title: Computable Bernstein Certificates for Cross-Fitted Clipped Covariance Estimation

author.name: Even He, Zaizai Yan

entry.summary: Proposes a cross-fitted clipped covariance estimator with computable Bernstein-type certificates for heavy-tailed data with outliers, enabling principled data-driven tuning of the clipping level.

entry.title: A Bayesian Approach to Low-Discrepancy Subset Selection

author.name: Nathan Kirk

entry.summary: Proves NP-hardness of kernel discrepancy-based subset selection and proposes a Bayesian Optimization procedure for finding low-discrepancy subsets, relevant to quasi-Monte Carlo methods.

entry.title: The Signal Horizon: Local Blindness and the Contraction of Pauli-Weight Spectra in Noisy Quantum Encodings

author.name: Ait Haddou Marwan

entry.summary: Analyzes how locality-constrained measurements limit class information accessibility in noisy quantum classifiers, introducing a k-local Pauli-accessible signal metric that predicts classification difficulty.

entry.title: Multi-dimensional Persistent Sheaf Laplacians for Image Analysis

author.name: Xiang Xiang Wang, Guo-Wei Wei

entry.summary: Proposes multi-dimensional persistent sheaf Laplacians (MPSL) for image analysis, exploiting complementary advantages of multiple reduced dimensions rather than selecting a single one.

entry.title: Multimodal Consistency-Guided Reference-Free Data Selection for ASR Accent Adaptation

author.name: Ligong Lei, Wenwen Lu, Xudong Pang, Zaokere Kadeer, Aishan Wumaier

entry.summary: Introduces a multimodal consistency-guided, reference-free data selection pipeline for ASR accent adaptation that goes beyond text-centric heuristics like perplexity filtering. Uses submodular mutual information for target-aware preselection to improve query relevance.

entry.title: Context Shapes LLMs Retrieval-Augmented Fact-Checking Effectiveness

author.name: Pietro Bernardelle, Stefano Civelli, Kevin Roitero, Gianluca Demartini

entry.summary: Studies how evidence placement and context length affect LLM-based fact verification across three datasets and five models, finding that parametric knowledge is non-trivial and verification accuracy declines with increased context.

entry.title: Query as Anchor: Scenario-Adaptive User Representation via Large Language Model

author.name: Jiahao Yuan, Yike Xu, Jinyong Wen, Baokun Wang, Ziyi Gao, Xiaotong Lin, Yun Liu, Xing Fu, Yu Cheng, Yongchao Liu, Weiqiang Wang, Zhongle Xie

entry.summary: Proposes Query-as-Anchor, a framework for dynamic, query-aware user representation learning using LLMs. Constructs UserU, an industrial-scale pre-training dataset aligning multi-modal behavioral sequences with user understanding semantics.

entry.title: The Wikidata Query Logs Dataset

author.name: Sebastian Walter, Hannah Bast

entry.summary: Presents the Wikidata Query Logs dataset of 200k question-query pairs, 6x larger than existing Wikidata datasets, constructed from real SPARQL queries using an agent-based de-anonymization method.

entry.title: Counterfactual Fairness Evaluation of LLM-Based Contact Center Agent Quality Assurance System

author.name: Kawin Mayilvaghanan, Siddhant Gupta, Ayush Kumar

entry.summary: Evaluates counterfactual fairness of LLM-based contact center QA systems across 13 dimensions spanning identity, context, and behavioral style, using Counterfactual Flip Rate and Mean Absolute Score Difference metrics.

entry.title: Reshaping MOFs text mining with a dynamic multi-agents framework of large language model

author.name: Zuhong Lin, Daoyuan Ren, Kai Ran, Jing Sun, Songlin Yu, Xuefeng Bai, Xiaotian Huang, Haiyang He, Pengxu Pan, Ying Fang, Zhanglin Li, Haipu Li, Jingjing Yao

entry.summary: Presents MOFh6, an LLM-driven system for extracting metal-organic framework synthesis conditions from literature, achieving 99% extraction accuracy and 94.1% abbreviation resolution across five major publishers.

entry.title: COOPERTRIM: Adaptive Data Selection for Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Perception

author.name: Shilpa Mukhopadhyay, Amit Roy-Chowdhury, Hang Qiu

entry.summary: Proposes COOPERTRIM for cooperative perception that exploits temporal continuity to identify features capturing environment dynamics, avoiding redundant transmission of static information to reduce bandwidth requirements.

entry.title: A WDLoRA-Based Multimodal Generative Framework for Clinically Guided Corneal Confocal Microscopy Image Synthesis in Diabetic Neuropathy

author.name: Xin Zhang, Liangxiu Han, Yue Shi, Yalin Zheng, Uazman Alam, Maryam Ferdousi, Rayaz Malik

entry.summary: Proposes WDLoRA (Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation) for generating synthetic corneal confocal microscopy images for diabetic neuropathy analysis. Addresses data scarcity in specialized medical imaging.

entry.title: Generative Latent Representations of 3D Brain MRI for Multi-Task Downstream Analysis in Down Syndrome

author.name: Jordi Mal\'e, Juan Fortea, Mateus Rozalem-Aranha, Neus Mart\'inez-Abad\'ias, Xavier Sevillano

entry.summary: Develops variational autoencoders for 3D brain MRI in Down Syndrome, exploring latent representations for multiple downstream clinical tasks. Investigates structure and information content of learned representations.

entry.title: Human-Aligned Evaluation of a Pixel-wise DNN Color Constancy Model

author.name: Hamed Heidari-Gorji, Raquel Gil Rodriguez, Karl R. Gegenfurtner

entry.summary: Compares a DNN color constancy model against human performance using the same achromatic selection task in virtual reality, evaluating mechanisms like local surround and spatial mean.

entry.title: Explainability-Inspired Layer-Wise Pruning of Deep Neural Networks for Efficient Object Detection

author.name: Abhinav Shukla, Nachiket Tapas

entry.summary: Proposes an explainability-inspired pruning framework using SHAP-inspired gradient-activation attribution for layer importance estimation in object detection models.

entry.title: Prototype Instance-semantic Disentanglement with Low-rank Regularized Subspace Clustering for WSIs Explainable Recognition

author.name: Chentao Li, Pan Huang

entry.summary: Proposes PID-LRSC for whole slide image classification using prototype-based instance-semantic disentanglement with low-rank subspace clustering to handle the dominance of non-tumor instances.

entry.title: Architectural Insights for Post-Tornado Damage Recognition

author.name: Robinson Umeike (Lisa), Thang Dao (Lisa), Shane Crawford (Lisa), John van de Lindt (Lisa), Blythe Johnston (Lisa), Wanting (Lisa), Wang, Trung Do, Ajibola Mofikoya, Sarbesh Banjara, Cuong Pham

entry.summary: Evaluates 79 deep learning models across 2,300+ experiments for post-tornado building damage assessment, addressing domain shift and class imbalance in disaster imagery.

entry.title: Integrating Affordances and Attention models for Short-Term Object Interaction Anticipation

author.name: Lorenzo Mur Labadia, Ruben Martinez-Cantin, Jose J. Guerrero, Giovanni M. Farinella, Antonino Furnari

entry.summary: Proposes attention-based architectures with affordance integration for short-term object interaction anticipation in egocentric video, combining frame-guided temporal pooling with dual attention mechanisms.

entry.title: High-fidelity 3D reconstruction for planetary exploration

author.name: Alfonso Mart\'inez-Petersen, Levin Gerdes, David Rodr\'iguez-Mart\'inez, C. J. P\'erez-del-Pulgar

entry.summary: Explores using modern 3D reconstruction techniques (likely NeRF/3DGS-based) for planetary exploration scenarios where traditional SfM and SLAM struggle with low-texture extraterrestrial terrains and communication delays.

entry.title: Fast Surrogate Learning for Multi-Objective UAV Placement in Motorway Intelligent Transportation System

author.name: Weian Guo, Shixin Deng, Wuzhao Li, Li Li

entry.summary: Addresses multi-objective UAV placement for motorway transportation using fast surrogate models trained on Pareto-optimal labels from NSGA-II. Uses permutation-aware losses for unordered vehicle positions across set-based and sequence-based architectures.

entry.title: FC-Vision: Real-Time Visibility-Aware Replanning for Occlusion-Free Aerial Target Structure Scanning in Unknown Environments

author.name: Chen Feng, Yang Xu, Shaojie Shen

entry.summary: FC-Vision is a visibility-aware replanning framework for aerial scanning drones that proactively prevents target occlusions by obstacles while maintaining coverage and efficiency, using a two-level decomposition for real-time performance.

entry.title: Impact-Robust Posture Optimization for Aerial Manipulation

author.name: Amr Afifi, Ahmad Gazar, Javier Alonso-Mora, Paolo Robuffo Giordano, Antonio Franchi

entry.summary: Presents a method for optimizing robot posture during aerial manipulation to minimize velocity changes during impacts, formulated as a min-max optimization reformulated as a real-time gradient-based motion task.

entry.title: Push-Placement: A Hybrid Approach Integrating Prehensile and Non-Prehensile Manipulation for Object Rearrangement

author.name: Majid Sadeghinejad, Arman Barghi, Hamed Hosseini, Mehdi Tale Masouleh, Ahmad Kalhor

entry.summary: Proposes push-placement, a hybrid action primitive where a grasped object displaces obstructing items while being placed, integrated into MCTS planning. Reduces manipulator travel cost by up to 11.12% in tabletop rearrangement tasks.

entry.title: Simulation-based Learning of Electrical Cabinet Assembly Using Robot Skills

author.name: Arik Laemmle, Bal\'azs Andr\'as B\'alint, Philipp Tenbrock, Frank Naegele, David Traunecker, J\'ozsef V\'ancza, Marco F. Huber

entry.summary: Presents a simulation-driven approach for automating force-controlled electrical terminal assembly on DIN-rails using deep reinforcement learning with parametrizable robot skills, including analytical and rigid-body joining models.

entry.title: Scalable Multi-Robot Path Planning via Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization

author.name: Javier Gonz\'alez Villasmil

entry.summary: Investigates QUBO formulations for multi-agent path finding with BFS-based preprocessing achieving >95% variable reduction and time-windowed decomposition, tested with up to four robots on grid environments.

entry.title: From Snapshot Sensing to Persistent EM World Modeling: A Generative-Space Perspective for ISAC

author.name: Pin-Han Ho, Haoran Mei, Limei Peng, Yiming Miao, Kairan Liang, Yan Jiao

entry.summary: Introduces a generative-space framework for electromagnetic world modeling in wireless systems, where sensing is realized through controlled traversal of a low-dimensional excitation space spanning frequency, waveform, and physical embodiment.

entry.title: Foundation Model-Driven Semantic Change Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery

author.name: Hengtong Shen, Li Yan, Hong Xie, Yaxuan Wei, Xinhao Li, Wenfei Shen, Peixian Lv, Fei Tan

entry.summary: Proposes PerASCD for semantic change detection in remote sensing, driven by a foundation model to enhance multi-class bi-temporal change interpretation.

entry.title: Joint Task Assistance Planning via Nested Branch and Bound (Extended Version)

author.name: Omer Daube, Oren Salzman

entry.summary: Introduces Joint Task Assistance Planning where two robots coordinate paths - one executing a timed mission and another providing sensor support - solved via nested branch and bound to maximize assistance duration.

entry.title: DECKBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Frameworks for Academic Slide Generation and Editing

author.name: Daesik Jang, Morgan Lindsay Heisler, Linzi Xing, Yifei Li, Edward Wang, Ying Xiong, Yong Zhang, Zhenan Fan

entry.summary: DECKBench is a benchmark for evaluating multi-agent frameworks on academic slide generation and editing, assessing fidelity, coherence, layout quality, and multi-turn instruction following.

entry.title: LLM-Enhanced Rumor Detection via Virtual Node Induced Edge Prediction

author.name: Jiran Tao, Cheng Wang, Binyan Jiang

entry.title: Research Summary: February 16, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on foundational challenges in LLM evaluation, efficient training, and reasoning robustness. Soft Contamination reveals that semantic duplicates evade standard n-gram decontamination, undermining benchmark validity across the field—potentially the most consequential finding of the day.

  • Native Low-Rank Pretraining shows LLMs can be trained from scratch with exclusively factorized weights by controlling spectral norm growth, offering significant compute savings
  • ARTS identifies a 'Normalization Squeeze' pathology in RLVR that systematically suppresses valid but rare reasoning paths, proposing amortized tree search as a fix
  • Continuous diffusion language models can be steered to obey formal syntax constraints (regex, CFGs) via training-free guidance
  • A Frankenstein-style dissection of RL in vision-language models reveals RL selectively improves specific functional components rather than broadly enhancing reasoning

Architecture and safety insights are also prominent. Two papers target MoE Transformers: one identifies multi-head attention (not experts) as the primary source of catastrophic forgetting, while SD-MoE uses spectral decomposition to fix expert specialization collapse. On safety, CC-Delta leverages sparse autoencoders to detect jailbreak-relevant features, and MonoLoss proposes a single-pass objective for monosemantic SAE representations. Finally, a study of nine frontier reasoning models under multi-turn adversarial attacks catalogues five distinct failure modes including Self-Doubt and Social Conformity.

entry.title: Soft Contamination Means Benchmarks Test Shallow Generalization

author.name: Ari Spiesberger, Juan J. Vazquez, Nicky Pochinkov, Tom\'a\v{s} Gaven\v{c}iak, Peli Grietzer, Gavin Leech, Nandi Schoots

entry.summary: Demonstrates that 'soft contamination' (semantic duplicates not caught by n-gram decontamination) is widespread in LLM training data, finding semantic duplicates for 78% of CodeForces problems. Shows that benchmark improvements from such contamination don't transfer to genuinely novel problems.

entry.title: Stabilizing Native Low-Rank LLM Pretraining

author.name: Paul Janson, Edouard Oyallon, Eugene Belilovsky

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLMs can be stably trained from scratch with exclusively low-rank factorized weights by controlling spectral norm growth, eliminating the need for full-rank guidance required by prior methods. Achieves performance matching dense models.

entry.title: Continuous Diffusion Models Can Obey Formal Syntax

author.name: Jinwoo Kim, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick, Loris D'Antoni

entry.summary: Introduces a training-free guidance method for steering continuous diffusion language models to satisfy formal syntactic constraints (regular expressions) by constructing an analytic score function and using its gradient during sampling.

entry.title: What does RL improve for Visual Reasoning? A Frankenstein-Style Analysis

author.name: Xirui Li, Ming Li and Tianyi Zhou

entry.summary: Uses a 'Frankenstein-style' analysis to dissect what RL actually improves in vision-language models compared to supervised fine-tuning, finding that RL primarily induces inference-time shifts in mid-to-late layers that are transferable and composable via model merging.

entry.title: Multi-Head Attention as a Source of Catastrophic Forgetting in MoE Transformers

author.name: Anrui Chen, Ruijun Huang, Xin Zhang, Fang Dong, Hengjie Cao, Zhendong Huang, Yifeng Yang, Mengyi Chen, Jixian Zhou, Mingzhi Dong, Yujiang Wang, Jinlong Hou, Qin Lv, Robert P. Dick, Yuan Cheng, Tun Lu, Fan Yang, Li Shang

entry.summary: Identifies multi-head attention as a key source of catastrophic forgetting in Mixture-of-Experts Transformers, attributing it to a pre-routing bottleneck where attention concatenates signals into a single router input. This forces routing to act on co-occurring feature compositions rather than separable channels, undermining sparse expert utilization for continual learning.

entry.title: Amortized Reasoning Tree Search: Decoupling Proposal and Decision in Large Language Models

author.name: Zesheng Hong, Jiadong Yu, Hui Pan

entry.summary: Identifies a 'Normalization Squeeze' pathology in RLVR where valid but rare reasoning paths are systematically suppressed. Proposes ARTS (Amortized Reasoning Tree Search) to maintain reasoning diversity by decoupling proposal from decision.

entry.title: Sparse Autoencoders are Capable LLM Jailbreak Mitigators

author.name: Yannick Assogba, Jacopo Cortellazzi, Javier Abad, Pau Rodriguez, Xavier Suau, Arno Blaas

entry.summary: Proposes CC-Delta, a defense against LLM jailbreaks using sparse autoencoders to identify jailbreak-relevant features by comparing representations of harmful requests with and without jailbreak context, then steering in SAE latent space at inference time.

entry.title: SD-MoE: Spectral Decomposition for Effective Expert Specialization

author.name: Ruijun Huang, Fang Dong, Xin Zhang, Hengjie Cao, Zhendong Huang, Anrui Chen, Jixian Zhou, Mengyi Chen, Yifeng Yang, Mingzhi Dong, Yujiang Wang, Jinlong Hou, Qin Lv, Robert P. Dick, Yuan Cheng, Fan Yang, Tun Lu, Chun Zhang, Li Shang

entry.summary: Proposes SD-MoE, a spectral decomposition approach for improving expert specialization in MoE LLMs. Identifies that experts share overlapping dominant spectral components and gating routes along these directions, then proposes spectral regularization to improve differentiation.

entry.title: MonoLoss: A Training Objective for Interpretable Monosemantic Representations

author.name: Ali Nasiri-Sarvi and Anh Tien Nguyen and Hassan Rivaz and Dimitris Samaras and Mahdi S. Hosseini

entry.summary: Proposes MonoLoss, a training objective for encouraging monosemantic representations in sparse autoencoders. Derives a single-pass algorithm that computes the MonoScore metric with linear rather than quadratic cost, achieving up to 1200x speedup.

entry.title: VI-CuRL: Stabilizing Verifier-Independent RL Reasoning via Confidence-Guided Variance Reduction

author.name: Xin-Qiang Cai, Masashi Sugiyama

entry.summary: Introduces VI-CuRL, a verifier-independent curriculum RL framework using intrinsic model confidence to construct curricula, addressing gradient variance and training collapse in RLVR without external verifiers.

entry.title: SciAgentGym: Benchmarking Multi-Step Scientific Tool-use in LLM Agents

author.name: Yujiong Shen, Yajie Yang, Zhiheng Xi, Binze Hu, Huayu Sha, Jiazheng Zhang, Qiyuan Peng, Junlin Shang, Jixuan Huang, Yutao Fan, Jingqi Tong, Shihan Dou, Ming Zhang, Lei Bai, Zhenfei Yin, Tao Gui, Xingjun Ma, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces SciAgentGym with 1,780 domain-specific tools across four science disciplines and SciAgentBench for evaluating LLM agents on multi-step scientific tool use. Shows GPT-5 success drops from 60.6% to 30.9% on complex tasks.

entry.title: Consistency of Large Reasoning Models Under Multi-Turn Attacks

author.name: Yubo Li, Ramayya Krishnan, Rema Padman

entry.summary: Evaluates nine frontier reasoning models under multi-turn adversarial attacks, identifying five failure modes including Self-Doubt and Social Conformity. Finds reasoning provides meaningful but incomplete robustness, with all models showing distinct vulnerability profiles.

entry.title: Constraint-Rectified Training for Efficient Chain-of-Thought

author.name: Qinhang Wu, Sen Lin, Ming Zhang, Yingbin Liang, Ness B. Shroff

entry.summary: Introduces Constraint-Rectified Training (CRT) for efficient chain-of-thought reasoning that balances reasoning length and accuracy through a principled constrained optimization approach, avoiding heuristic length penalties.

entry.title: Rational Neural Networks have Expressivity Advantages

author.name: Maosen Tang and Alex Townsend

entry.summary: Proves that neural networks with trainable low-degree rational activation functions are exponentially more parameter-efficient than standard fixed activations (ReLU, SiLU, etc.) through approximation-theoretic separations. The gap is shown to persist at the level of full networks and extends to gated activations.

entry.title: To Mix or To Merge: Toward Multi-Domain Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models

author.name: Haoqing Wang, Xiang Long, Ziheng Li, Yilong Xu, Tingguang Li, Yehui Tang

entry.summary: Compares two paradigms for multi-domain RLVR in LLMs — mixed multi-task RL training vs. separate domain RL followed by model merging — providing detailed analysis of when each approach is preferable across math, coding, science, and instruction following.

entry.title: TensorCommitments: A Lightweight Verifiable Inference for Language Models

author.name: Oguzhan Baser, Elahe Sadeghi, Eric Wang, David Ribeiro Alves, Sam Kazemian, Hong Kang, Sandeep P. Chinchali, Sriram Vishwanath

entry.summary: Proposes TensorCommitments, a cryptographic proof-of-inference scheme for verifying LLM inference was executed correctly without rerunning the model. For LLaMA2, it adds only 0.97% prover and 0.12% verifier overhead while improving upon existing verification approaches.

entry.title: SkillsBench: Benchmarking How Well Agent Skills Work Across Diverse Tasks

author.name: Xiangyi Li, Wenbo Chen, Yimin Liu, Shenghan Zheng, Xiaokun Chen, Yifeng He, Yubo Li, Bingran You, Haotian Shen, Jiankai Sun, Shuyi Wang, Qunhong Zeng, Di Wang, Xuandong Zhao, Yuanli Wang, Roey Ben Chaim, Zonglin Di, Yipeng Gao, Junwei He, Yizhuo He, Liqiang Jing, Luyang Kong, Xin Lan, Jiachen Li, Songlin Li, Yijiang Li, Yueqian Lin, Xinyi Liu, Xuanqing Liu, Haoran Lyu, Ze Ma, Bowei Wang, Runhui Wang, Tianyu Wang, Wengao Ye, Yue Zhang, Hanwen Xing, Yiqi Xue, Steven Dillmann, and Han-chung Lee

entry.summary: Presents SkillsBench, a benchmark of 86 tasks across 11 domains testing whether structured procedural knowledge ('Skills') helps LLM agents. Finds curated Skills improve pass rates by 16.2pp on average, but self-generated Skills provide no benefit, revealing models cannot reliably author procedural knowledge.

entry.title: FLAC: Maximum Entropy RL via Kinetic Energy Regularized Bridge Matching

author.name: Lei Lv, Yunfei Li, Yu Luo, Fuchun Sun, Xiao Ma

entry.summary: Proposes FLAC, a likelihood-free maximum entropy RL framework that uses kinetic energy regularization of velocity fields instead of requiring explicit action densities. Formulates policy optimization as a Generalized Schrödinger Bridge problem.

entry.title: BrowseComp-$V^3$: A Visual, Vertical, and Verifiable Benchmark for Multimodal Browsing Agents

author.name: Huanyao Zhang, Jiepeng Zhou, Bo Li, Bowen Zhou, Yanzhe Dan, Haishan Lu, Zhiyong Cao, Jiaoyang Chen, Yuqian Han, Zinan Sheng, Zhengwei Tao, Hao Liang, Jialong Wu, Yang Shi, Yuanpeng He, Jiaye Lin, Qintong Zhang, Guochen Yan, Runhao Zhao, Zhengpin Li, Xiaohan Yu, Lang Mei, Chong Chen, Wentao Zhang, Bin Cui

entry.summary: Introduces BrowseComp-V³, a benchmark of 300 challenging questions for multimodal browsing agents requiring deep cross-modal multi-hop reasoning across text and visual modalities, addressing limitations in existing browsing benchmarks.

entry.title: GPTZero: Robust Detection of LLM-Generated Texts

author.name: George Alexandru Adam, Alexander Cui, Edwin Thomas, Emily Napier, Nazar Shmatko, Jacob Schnell, Jacob Junqi Tian, Alekhya Dronavalli, Edward Tian, Dongwon Lee

entry.summary: Presents GPTZero, an industrial AI text detection system using a hierarchical multi-task architecture that distinguishes human from LLM-generated text with state-of-the-art accuracy. Introduces methods for handling diverse writing styles, adversarial attacks, and granular predictions.

entry.title: A Theoretical Analysis of Mamba's Training Dynamics: Filtering Relevant Features for Generalization in State Space Models

author.name: Mugunthan Shandirasegaran, Hongkang Li, Songyang Zhang, Meng Wang, Shuai Zhang

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of Mamba's training dynamics for a simplified single-layer selective SSM, proving guaranteed generalization under majority-voting and locality-structured data with non-asymptotic bounds.

entry.title: Scaling Web Agent Training through Automatic Data Generation and Fine-grained Evaluation

author.name: Lajanugen Logeswaran, Jaekyeom Kim, Sungryull Sohn, Creighton Glasscock, Honglak Lee

entry.summary: Presents a scalable pipeline for automatically generating web agent training data, with a novel constraint-based evaluation framework for fine-grained assessment of partial task completion, evaluated on the new BookingArena benchmark.

entry.title: Beyond Normalization: Rethinking the Partition Function as a Difficulty Scheduler for RLVR

author.name: Dohyung Kim, Minbeom Kim, Jeonghye Kim, Sangmook Lee, Sojeong Rhee, Kyomin Jung

entry.summary: Reinterprets the partition function in GFlowNet-based LLM training as a per-prompt expected reward signal, proposing PACED-RL which uses accuracy estimates to prioritize informative questions as a difficulty scheduler. Improves sample efficiency in reasoning LLM training.

entry.title: MedXIAOHE: A Comprehensive Recipe for Building Medical MLLMs

author.name: Baorong Shi, Bo Cui, Boyuan Jiang, Deli Yu, Fang Qian, Haihua Yang, Huichao Wang, Jiale Chen, Jianfei Pan, Jieqiong Cao, Jinghao Lin, Kai Wu, Lin Yang, Shengsheng Yao, Tao Chen, Xiaojun Xiao, Xiaozhong Ji, Xu Wang, Yijun He, Zhixiong Yang

entry.summary: Presents MedXIAOHE, a medical vision-language foundation model achieving SOTA on diverse medical benchmarks, using entity-aware continual pretraining, reinforcement learning for medical reasoning, and tool-augmented agentic training for multi-step diagnostic reasoning.

entry.title: WebClipper: Efficient Evolution of Web Agents with Graph-based Trajectory Pruning

author.name: Junjie Wang, Zequn Xie, Dan Yang, Jie Feng, Yue Shen, Duolin Sun, Meixiu Long, Yihan Jiao, Zhehao Tan, Jian Wang, Peng Wei, Jinjie Gu

entry.summary: Proposes WebClipper, which compresses web agent trajectories via graph-based pruning by modeling search as a state graph and finding minimum-necessary DAGs. Training on pruned trajectories improves agent efficiency while maintaining or improving accuracy.

entry.title: Transporting Task Vectors across Different Architectures without Training

author.name: Filippo Rinaldi, Aniello Panariello, Giacomo Salici, Angelo Porrello, Simone Calderara

entry.summary: Introduces Theseus, a training-free method for transferring task-specific parameter updates across models of different architectures/widths by characterizing updates through their functional effects on representations using Procrustes alignment.

entry.title: How cyborg propaganda reshapes collective action

author.name: Jonas R. Kunst, Kinga Bierwiaczonek, Meeyoung Cha, Omid V. Ebrahimi, Marc Fawcett-Atkinson, Asbj{\o}rn F{\o}lstad, Anton Gollwitzer, Nils K\"obis, Gary Marcus, Jon Roozenbeek, Daniel Thilo Schroeder, Jay J. Van Bavel, Sander van der Linden, Rory White, and Live Leonhardsen Wilhelmsen

entry.summary: Defines 'cyborg propaganda' as the convergence of partisan coordination apps and AI that combines verified human users with algorithmic automation, creating a regulatory gray zone that evades existing bot-detection frameworks.

entry.title: GT-HarmBench: Benchmarking AI Safety Risks Through the Lens of Game Theory

author.name: Pepijn Cobben, Xuanqiang Angelo Huang, Thao Amelia Pham, Isabel Dahlgren, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Zhijing Jin

entry.summary: Introduces GT-HarmBench, a benchmark of 2,009 game-theoretic scenarios for evaluating AI safety in multi-agent settings. Tests 15 frontier models and finds agents choose socially beneficial actions only 62% of the time.

entry.title: propella-1: Multi-Property Document Annotation for LLM Data Curation at Scale

author.name: Maximilian Idahl, Benedikt Droste, Bj\"orn Pl\"uster, Jan Philipp Harries

entry.summary: Introduces propella-1, a family of small multilingual LLMs (0.6B-4B) that annotate documents across 18 properties in 57 languages for LLM pretraining data curation, replacing single scalar quality scores with structured multi-property annotations.

entry.title: Designing RNAs with Language Models

author.name: Milan Gautam, Ning Dai, Tianshuo Zhou, Bowen Xie, David Mathews and Liang Huang

entry.summary: Reframes RNA design as conditional sequence generation using an autoregressive language model, training first in supervised mode on structure-sequence pairs then optimizing with RL, achieving strong results on RNA design benchmarks.

entry.title: HyperMLP: An Integrated Perspective for Sequence Modeling

author.name: Jiecheng Lu and Shihao Yang

entry.summary: Proposes HyperMLP, which reframes autoregressive attention as a dynamic two-layer MLP whose weights are instantiated from context history. This perspective enables using standard MLP activations like ReLU/GLU for input-conditioned selection, introducing HyperMLP and HyperGLU variants.

entry.title: RelBench v2: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Repository for Relational Data

author.name: Justin Gu, Rishabh Ranjan, Charilaos Kanatsoulis, Haiming Tang, Martin Jurkovic, Valter Hudovernik, Mark Znidar, Pranshu Chaturvedi, Parth Shroff, Fengyu Li, Jure Leskovec

entry.summary: Introduces RelBench v2, expanding a relational deep learning benchmark to 11 datasets with 22M+ rows across 29 tables, adding new large-scale datasets and autocomplete tasks. From Jure Leskovec's group, it aims to drive progress toward relational foundation models.

entry.title: RLinf-Co: Reinforcement Learning-Based Sim-Real Co-Training for VLA Models

author.name: Liangzhi Shi, Shuaihang Chen, Feng Gao, Yinuo Chen, Kang Chen, Tonghe Zhang, Hongzhi Zhang, Weinan Zhang, Chao Yu, Yu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes RLinf-Co, a framework for training vision-language-action models using reinforcement learning in simulation while preserving real-world capabilities. Uses a two-stage approach: SFT warm-start on mixed data, then RL fine-tuning with interactive simulation.

entry.title: Learning Ordinal Probabilistic Reward from Preferences

author.name: Longze Chen, Lu Wang, Renke Shan, Ze Gong, Run Luo, Jiaming Li, Jing Luo, Qiyao Wang, Min Yang

entry.summary: Proposes OPRM (Ordinal Probabilistic Reward Model), which models rewards as probability distributions over ordinal quality levels rather than deterministic scalars. Offers a practical closed-form discrete realization that can be trained from preference data without point-wise supervision.

entry.title: Flow Matching from Viewpoint of Proximal Operators

author.name: Kenji Fukumizu, Wei Huang, Han Bao, Shuntuo Xu, Nisha Chandramoothy

entry.summary: Reformulates Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching through proximal operators, showing the target mapping is exactly a proximal operator via an extended Brenier potential. Proves terminal normal hyperbolicity for manifold-supported targets.

entry.title: RAT-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Text Anonymization

author.name: Nata\v{s}a Kr\v{c}o, Zexi Yao, Matthieu Meeus, Yves-Alexandre de Montjoye

entry.summary: Introduces RAT-Bench, a benchmark evaluating text anonymization tools based on re-identification risk rather than just identifier removal. Tests NER- and LLM-based anonymization tools using synthetic data with U.S. demographic statistics, revealing gaps in current approaches.

entry.title: Information-theoretic analysis of world models in optimal reward maximizers

author.name: Alfred Harwood, Jose Faustino, Alex Altair

entry.summary: Proves that observing an optimal deterministic policy for a CMP conveys exactly n log m bits of information about the environment, providing formal quantification of how much world knowledge optimal policies encode.

entry.title: ProbeLLM: Automating Principled Diagnosis of LLM Failures

author.name: Yue Huang, Zhengzhe Jiang, Yuchen Ma, Yu Jiang, Xiangqi Wang, Yujun Zhou, Yuexing Hao, Kehan Guo, Pin-Yu Chen, Stefan Feuerriegel, Xiangliang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ProbeLLM, a framework that uses hierarchical Monte Carlo Tree Search to systematically discover structured failure modes in LLMs, moving beyond isolated failure cases to principled weakness characterization.

entry.title: Look Inward to Explore Outward: Learning Temperature Policy from LLM Internal States via Hierarchical RL

author.name: Yixiao Zhou, Yang Li, Dongzhou Cheng, Hehe Fan, Yu Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes Introspective LLM, a hierarchical RL framework that learns to dynamically control sampling temperature during LLM generation based on the model's hidden state. Temperature and token policies are jointly optimized from downstream rewards.

entry.title: R-Diverse: Mitigating Diversity Illusion in Self-Play LLM Training

author.name: Gengsheng Li, Jinghan He, Shijie Wang, Dan Zhang, Ruiqi Liu, Renrui Zhang, Zijun Yao, Junfeng Fang, Haiyun Guo, Jinqiao Wang

entry.summary: Identifies 'Diversity Illusion' as a key failure mode in self-play LLM reasoning, where training signals appear diverse but collapse into recurring patterns. Proposes R-Diverse with global diversity memory and skill-aware generation to mitigate this.

entry.title: Steerable Vision-Language-Action Policies for Embodied Reasoning and Hierarchical Control

author.name: William Chen, Jagdeep Singh Bhatia, Catherine Glossop, Nikhil Mathihalli, Ria Doshi, Andy Tang, Danny Driess, Karl Pertsch, Sergey Levine

entry.summary: Introduces Steerable Policies - VLAs trained on rich synthetic commands at various abstraction levels (subtasks, motions, pixel coordinates) - to improve how VLM reasoning can control low-level robot behavior beyond just language instructions.

entry.title: Think Fast and Slow: Step-Level Cognitive Depth Adaptation for LLM Agents

author.name: Ruihan Yang, Fanghua Ye, Xiang We, Ruoqing Zhao, Kang Luo, Xinbo Xu, Bo Zhao, Ruotian Ma, Shanyi Wang, Zhaopeng Tu, Xiaolong Li, Deqing Yang, Linus

entry.summary: Introduces CogRouter, a framework that trains LLM agents to dynamically adapt cognitive depth at each step in multi-turn tasks, using four hierarchical cognitive levels from instinctive responses to strategic planning, grounded in ACT-R cognitive theory.

entry.title: Thinking Like a Radiologist: A Dataset for Anatomy-Guided Interleaved Vision Language Reasoning in Chest X-ray Interpretation

author.name: Yichen Zhao, Zelin Peng, Piao Yang, Xiaokang Yang, and Wei Shen

entry.summary: Introduces MMRad-IVL-22K, the first large-scale dataset for natively interleaved visual-language reasoning in chest X-ray interpretation, motivated by how radiologists repeatedly alternate between visual inspection and language reasoning.

entry.title: Free Lunch in Medical Image Foundation Model Pre-training via Randomized Synthesis and Disentanglement

author.name: Yuhan Wei, Yuting He, Linshan Wu, Fuxiang Huang, Junlin Hou, Hao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes RaSD, a framework for pre-training medical image foundation models entirely on synthetic data using randomized Gaussian distributions for anatomical structures. Pre-trained on 1.2M 3D volumes, achieves competitive or superior results to real-data methods.

entry.title: Abstractive Red-Teaming of Language Model Character

author.name: Nate Rahn, Allison Qi, Avery Griffin, Jonathan Michala, Henry Sleight, Erik Jones

entry.summary: Introduces abstractive red-teaming, searching for natural-language query categories that routinely elicit character specification violations in LLMs. Provides an efficient method to identify vulnerability patterns using much less than deployment-level compute.

entry.title: Intrinsic Credit Assignment for Long Horizon Interaction

author.name: Ilze Amanda Auzina and Joschka Str\"uber and Sergio Hern\'andez-Guti\'errez and Shashwat Goel and Ameya Prabhu and Matthias Bethge

entry.summary: Proposes ΔBelief-RL, which uses a language model's intrinsic belief changes as reward signals for intermediate progress in long-horizon interactions. Outperforms outcome-based RL rewards and generalizes to out-of-distribution applications.

entry.title: Agent Skills for Large Language Models: Architecture, Acquisition, Security, and the Path Forward

author.name: Renjun Xu and Yang Yan

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of agent skills for LLMs, covering the transition from monolithic models to modular skill-equipped agents, organized along architecture, acquisition, security, and integration axes including the SKILL.md specification and MCP.

entry.title: On Robustness and Chain-of-Thought Consistency of RL-Finetuned VLMs

author.name: Rosie Zhao, Anshul Shah, Xiaoyu Zhu, Xinke Deng, Zhongyu Jiang, Yang Yang, Joerg Liebelt, Arnab Mondal

entry.summary: Shows that RL-finetuned VLMs remain vulnerable to simple textual perturbations and that CoT consistency metrics reveal more pronounced drops than answer-only accuracy, with entropy-based analysis of how perturbations reshape model uncertainty.

entry.title: DiffuRank: Effective Document Reranking with Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Qi Liu, Kun Ai, Jiaxin Mao, Yanzhao Zhang, Mingxin Li, Dingkun Long, Pengjun Xie, Fengbin Zhu, Ji-Rong Wen

entry.summary: Proposes DiffuRank, using diffusion language models instead of autoregressive models for document reranking, enabling flexible parallel decoding and iterative refinement that avoids error propagation from left-to-right generation.

entry.title: CRAFT: Adapting VLA Models to Contact-rich Manipulation via Force-aware Curriculum Fine-tuning

author.name: Yike Zhang, Yaonan Wang, Xinxin Sun, Kaizhen Huang, Zhiyuan Xu, Junjie Ji, Zhengping Che, Jian Tang, Jingtao Sun

entry.summary: Introduces CRAFT, a force-aware curriculum fine-tuning framework for VLA models in contact-rich manipulation, using a variational information bottleneck to regulate vision/language embeddings and prioritize force signals during early training.

entry.title: The Constant Eye: Benchmarking and Bridging Appearance Robustness in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Jiabao Wang, Hongyu Zhou, Yuanbo Yang, Jiahao Shao, Yiyi Liao

entry.summary: Establishes navdream, a robustness benchmark for autonomous driving that isolates appearance-based shifts from structural changes using generative style transfer, revealing that many planners fail simply due to weather/lighting changes.

entry.title: Vision Token Reduction via Attention-Driven Self-Compression for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Omer Faruk Deniz, Ruiyu Mao, Ruochen Li, Yapeng Tian, Latifur Khan

entry.summary: Introduces ADSC, a method that progressively reduces vision tokens in multimodal LLMs using the LLM's own attention mechanism rather than external pruning heuristics. Applies uniform token downsampling at selected layers to form bottleneck points, compatible with FlashAttention.

entry.title: Unifying Model-Free Efficiency and Model-Based Representations via Latent Dynamics

author.name: Jashaswimalya Acharjee and Balaraman Ravindran

entry.summary: Presents Unified Latent Dynamics (ULD), a reinforcement learning algorithm that embeds state-action pairs into a latent space where value functions are approximately linear, unifying model-free efficiency with model-based representations without planning overhead.

entry.title: SLA2: Sparse-Linear Attention with Learnable Routing and QAT

author.name: Jintao Zhang, Haoxu Wang, Kai Jiang, Kaiwen Zheng, Youhe Jiang, Ion Stoica, Jianfei Chen, Jun Zhu, Joseph E. Gonzalez

entry.summary: Proposes SLA2, an improved sparse-linear attention mechanism for diffusion models with a learnable router for dynamic sparse/linear selection, a more faithful attention decomposition, and quantization-aware training for video generation efficiency.

entry.title: ALOE: Action-Level Off-Policy Evaluation for Vision-Language-Action Model Post-Training

author.name: Rushuai Yang, Hecheng Wang, Chiming Liu, Xiaohan Yan, Yunlong Wang, Xuan Du, Shuoyu Yue, Yongcheng Liu, Chuheng Zhang, Lizhe Qi, Yi Chen, Wei Shan, Maoqing Yao

entry.summary: Proposes ALOE, an action-level off-policy evaluation method for improving VLA models through online RL. Addresses the limitation of conservative on-policy estimation when learning from mixed data sources including historical policies and human interventions.

entry.title: Scaling Single Human Demonstrations for Imitation Learning using Generative Foundational Models

author.name: Nick Heppert, Minh Quang Nguyen, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Proposes Real2Gen, a method to train manipulation policies from a single human demonstration by transferring task information to simulation where a programmable agent generates unlimited training data for flow matching policy learning.

entry.title: PixelRush: Ultra-Fast, Training-Free High-Resolution Image Generation via One-step Diffusion

author.name: Hong-Phuc Lai, Phong Nguyen, Anh Tran

entry.summary: Introduces PixelRush, a training-free framework for high-resolution text-to-image generation that eliminates multiple inversion/regeneration cycles. Enables efficient patch-based denoising in low-step regimes, dramatically reducing generation time for 4K images from 5+ minutes.

entry.title: GRAIL: Geometry-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Inference with LLMs over Hyperbolic Representations of Patient Trajectories

author.name: Zhan Qu and Michael F\"arber

entry.summary: Proposes GRAIL, a framework using hyperbolic space embeddings and structured retrieval to predict clinical events from longitudinal EHRs, addressing LLM hallucination when reasoning over long structured patient histories.

entry.title: MentalBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Psychiatric Diagnostic Capability of Large Language Models

author.name: Hoyun Song, Migyeong Kang, Jisu Shin, Jihyun Kim, Chanbi Park, Hangyeol Yoo, Jihyun An, Alice Oh, Jinyoung Han, KyungTae Lim

entry.summary: Introduces MentalBench with a psychiatrist-built knowledge graph encoding DSM-5 criteria for 23 disorders, generating 24,750 synthetic clinical cases. Shows LLMs perform well on structured DSM-5 queries but struggle with realistic diagnostic reasoning.

entry.title: Learning Native Continuation for Action Chunking Flow Policies

author.name: Yufeng Liu, Hang Yu, Juntu Zhao, Bocheng Li, Di Zhang, Mingzhu Li, Wenxuan Wu, Yingdong Hu, Junyuan Xie, Junliang Guo, Dequan Wang, Yang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes Legato, a training-time continuation method for action-chunked flow-based VLA policies that addresses discontinuities at chunk boundaries by initializing denoising from a mixture of known actions and noise.

entry.title: Towards Universal Video MLLMs with Attribute-Structured and Quality-Verified Instructions

author.name: Yunheng Li, Hengrui Zhang, Meng-Hao Guo, Wenzhao Gao, Shaoyong Jia, Shaohui Jiao, Qibin Hou, Ming-Ming Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces ASID-1M, a million-scale structured audiovisual instruction dataset with fine-grained attribute annotations and automatic quality verification for training universal video MLLMs. Also presents ASID-Cap, a new video captioning module. Addresses the data quality bottleneck in video understanding.

entry.title: Diverging Flows: Detecting Extrapolations in Conditional Generation

author.name: Constantinos Tsakonas, Serena Ivaldi, Jean-Baptiste Mouret

entry.summary: Introduces Diverging Flows, a method that enables flow matching models to simultaneously perform conditional generation and detect extrapolation by structurally enforcing inefficient transport for off-manifold inputs, addressing silent failure risks.

entry.title: Memory-Efficient Structured Backpropagation for On-Device LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Juneyoung Park, Yuri Hong, Seongwan Kim, Jaeho Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Memory-efficient Structured Backpropagation (MeSP) that exploits LoRA's low-rank structure to reduce memory for on-device LLM fine-tuning by 49% while computing mathematically identical gradients, by recomputing the low-rank intermediate projection during backward passes.

entry.title: LongStream: Long-Sequence Streaming Autoregressive Visual Geometry

author.name: Chong Cheng, Xianda Chen, Tao Xie, Wei Yin, Weiqiang Ren, Qian Zhang, Xiaoyuang Guo, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Introduces LongStream, a streaming visual geometry model for metric-scale 3D reconstruction across thousands of frames, using keyframe-relative poses, orthogonal scale learning, and Transformer cache solutions to handle long sequences.

entry.title: Semantic Chunking and the Entropy of Natural Language

author.name: Weishun Zhong, Doron Sivan, Tankut Can, Mikhail Katkov, Misha Tsodyks

entry.summary: Introduces a statistical model for the multi-scale structure of natural language through hierarchical semantic chunking, providing a first-principles account of English's ~80% redundancy. Validated with modern LLMs and open datasets.

entry.title: From Biased Chatbots to Biased Agents: Examining Role Assignment Effects on LLM Agent Robustness

author.name: Linbo Cao, Lihao Sun, Yang Yue

entry.summary: First systematic study showing that demographic-based persona assignments can degrade LLM agent task performance by up to 26.2% across strategic reasoning, planning, and technical operations benchmarks.

entry.title: ForeAct: Steering Your VLA with Efficient Visual Foresight Planning

author.name: Zhuoyang Zhang, Shang Yang, Qinghao Hu, Luke J. Huang, James Hou, Yufei Sun, Yao Lu, Song Han

entry.summary: Presents ForeAct, a visual foresight planner for Vision-Language-Action models that generates imagined future observations to guide step-by-step robot action. Achieves 0.33s generation of 640x480 future observations on H100.

entry.title: Synthetic Interaction Data for Scalable Personalization in Large Language Models

author.name: Yuchen Ma, Yue Huang, Wenjie Wang, Xiaonan Luo, Xiangliang Zhang, Stefan Feuerriegel

entry.summary: Introduces PersonaGym, a synthetic data generation framework for personalized LLM interactions that models dynamic user preferences through an agentic LLM system, addressing the lack of high-quality personalization training data.

entry.title: RankLLM: Weighted Ranking of LLMs by Quantifying Question Difficulty

author.name: Ziqian Zhang, Xingjian Hu, Yue Huang, Kai Zhang, Ruoxi Chen, Yixin Liu, Qingsong Wen, Kaidi Xu, Xiangliang Zhang, Neil Zhenqiang Gong, and Lichao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes RankLLM, a framework that quantifies question difficulty and model competency through bidirectional score propagation, enabling more fine-grained LLM evaluation that differentiates model capabilities based on question difficulty.

entry.title: Monocular Reconstruction of Neural Tactile Fields

author.name: Pavan Mantripragada, Siddhanth Deshmukh, Eadom Dessalene, Manas Desai, Yiannis Aloimonos

entry.summary: Introduces neural tactile fields, a 3D representation mapping spatial locations to expected tactile responses, predicted from a single RGB image and enabling path planning that distinguishes between high- and low-resistance obstacles.

entry.title: Self-Supervised JEPA-based World Models for LiDAR Occupancy Completion and Forecasting

author.name: Haoran Zhu, Anna Choromanska

entry.summary: Proposes AD-LiST-JEPA, a self-supervised world model for autonomous driving that predicts future spatiotemporal evolution from LiDAR data using the JEPA (joint-embedding predictive architecture) framework.

entry.title: Can I Have Your Order? Monte-Carlo Tree Search for Slot Filling Ordering in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Joshua Ong Jun Leang, Yu Zhao, Mihaela C\u{a}t\u{a}lina Stoian, Wenda Li, Shay B. Cohen, Eleonora Giunchiglia

entry.summary: Introduces McDiffuSE, a framework that uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to optimize the slot-filling order in Masked Diffusion Models for code and math reasoning. It achieves notable improvements over autoregressive baselines (3.2% average, 19.5% on MBPP) by using look-ahead simulations to evaluate partial completions before committing.

entry.title: AI Agents for Inventory Control: Human-LLM-OR Complementarity

author.name: Jackie Baek, Yaopeng Fu, Will Ma, Tianyi Peng

entry.summary: Studies how OR algorithms, LLMs, and humans can complement each other for inventory control, introducing InventoryBench with 1000+ inventory instances. Finds that hybrid Human-LLM-OR approaches outperform individual methods, with LLMs providing flexible reasoning for distribution shifts.

entry.title: Hierarchical Successor Representation for Robust Transfer

author.name: Changmin Yu, M\'at\'e Lengyel

entry.summary: Proposes Hierarchical Successor Representation (HSR) that incorporates temporal abstractions to overcome policy dependence and spectral diffusion limitations of classical successor representations, enabling robust transfer across changing tasks and environments.

entry.title: Closing the Loop: A Control-Theoretic Framework for Provably Stable Time Series Forecasting with LLMs

author.name: Xingyu Zhang, Hanyun Du, Zeen Song, Jianqi Zhang, Changwen Zheng, Wenwen Qiang

entry.summary: Proposes F-LLM, reformulating autoregressive LLM forecasting through control theory, introducing a closed-loop feedback framework that reduces error accumulation (exposure bias) during long-horizon time series prediction.

entry.title: Left-right asymmetry in predicting brain activity from LLMs' representations emerges with their formal linguistic competence

author.name: Laurent Bonnasse-Gahot and Christophe Pallier

entry.summary: Shows that left-right brain asymmetry in predicting brain activity from LLM representations emerges alongside the model's formal linguistic competence during training. Uses OLMo-2 7B at various checkpoints with fMRI data to link linguistic competence to hemispheric lateralization.

entry.title: TRACE: Temporal Reasoning via Agentic Context Evolution for Streaming Electronic Health Records (EHRs)

author.name: Zhan Qu and Michael F\"arber

entry.summary: Introduces TRACE, a framework enabling temporal clinical reasoning with frozen LLMs via a dual-memory architecture (static global protocol + dynamic patient chronicle) rather than fine-tuning or extending context windows.

entry.title: Training-Free Acceleration for Document Parsing Vision-Language Model with Hierarchical Speculative Decoding

author.name: Wenhui Liao, Hongliang Li, Pengyu Xie, Xinyu Cai, Yufan Shen, Yi Xin, Qi Qin, Shenglong Ye, Tianbin Li, Ming Hu, Junjun He, Yihao Liu, Wenhai Wang, Min Dou, Bin Fu, Botian Shi, Yu Qiao, Lianwen Jin

entry.summary: Proposes hierarchical speculative decoding for accelerating VLM-based document parsing, using a lightweight document parsing pipeline as a draft model to accelerate autoregressive token generation.

entry.title: Buy versus Build an LLM: A Decision Framework for Governments

author.name: Jiahao Lu, Ziwei Xu, William Tjhi, Junnan Li, Antoine Bosselut, Pang Wei Koh, Mohan Kankanhalli

entry.summary: Presents a decision framework for governments choosing between buying existing LLM services from foreign corporations, building domestic capabilities, or adopting hybrid approaches. Analyzes sovereignty, security, and capability trade-offs across different public-sector use cases.

entry.title: LCSB: Layer-Cyclic Selective Backpropagation for Memory-Efficient On-Device LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Juneyoung Park, Eunbeen Yoon, Seongwan Kim. Jaeho Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Layer-Cyclic Selective Backpropagation (LCSB) for memory-efficient on-device LLM fine-tuning, computing gradients for only a subset of layers per step. Interprets the approach as Block Coordinate Descent on LoRA parameters.

entry.title: Which Algorithms Can Graph Neural Networks Learn?

author.name: Solveig Wittig, Antonis Vasileiou, Robert R. Nerem, Timo Stoll, Floris Geerts, Yusu Wang, and Christopher Morris

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical framework characterizing sufficient conditions for GNNs to learn and generalize discrete algorithms, going beyond expressivity analysis to address when GNN architectures generalize from finite training sets in neural algorithmic reasoning.

entry.title: CoPE-VideoLM: Codec Primitives For Efficient Video Language Models

author.name: Sayan Deb Sarkar, R\'emi Pautrat, Ondrej Miksik, Marc Pollefeys, Iro Armeni, Mahdi Rad, Mihai Dusmanu

entry.summary: Proposes CoPE-VideoLM, which leverages video codec primitives (motion vectors, residuals) instead of full image encoding for most frames in video language models, achieving better temporal coverage with reduced computation.

entry.title: OptiML: An End-to-End Framework for Program Synthesis and CUDA Kernel Optimization

author.name: Arijit Bhattacharjee, Heng Ping, Son Vu Le, Paul Bogdan, Nesreen K. Ahmed, Ali Jannesari

entry.summary: Presents OptiML, an end-to-end framework that maps natural language or CUDA code to performance-optimized CUDA kernels through a Mixture-of-Thoughts generator and search-based optimization with verification.

entry.title: Self-Refining Vision Language Model for Robotic Failure Detection and Reasoning

author.name: Carl Qi, Xiaojie Wang, Silong Yong, Stephen Sheng, Huitan Mao, Sriram Srinivasan, Manikantan Nambi, Amy Zhang, Yesh Dattatreya

entry.summary: Introduces ARMOR, a self-refining vision-language model for robotic failure detection that formulates detection and reasoning as a multi-task self-refinement process, learning from heterogeneous supervision signals.

entry.title: RBCorr: Response Bias Correction in Language Models

author.name: Om Bhatt, Anna A. Ivanova

entry.summary: Proposes RBCorr, a simple response bias correction strategy for language models tested on 12 open-weight models across different question types. Shows response bias is prevalent and that correction effectively eliminates bias and improves performance.

entry.title: Human-Like Coarse Object Representations in Vision Models

author.name: Andrey Gizdov, Andrea Procopio, Yichen Li, Daniel Harari, Tomer Ullman

entry.summary: Studies whether segmentation models acquire human-like coarse object representations for physics, finding an inverse U-shaped curve where intermediate-capacity models best match human behavior.

entry.title: Flow-Factory: A Unified Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Flow-Matching Models

author.name: Bowen Ping, Chengyou Jia, Minnan Luo, Hangwei Qian, Ivor Tsang

entry.summary: Introduces Flow-Factory, a unified framework decoupling algorithms, models, and rewards for RL-based alignment of flow-matching models, supporting GRPO, DiffusionNFT, and AWM across multiple image and video models.

entry.title: Formalizing the Sampling Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models via Adaptive Solvers and Wasserstein-Bounded Timesteps

author.name: Sangwoo Jo, Sungjoon Choi

entry.summary: Already analyzed above.

entry.title: ImageRAGTurbo: Towards One-step Text-to-Image Generation with Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Models

author.name: Peijie Qiu, Hariharan Ramshankar, Arnau Ramisa, Ren\'e Vidal, Amit Kumar K C, Vamsi Salaka, Rahul Bhagat

entry.summary: Proposes ImageRAGTurbo, which enhances few-step diffusion models via retrieval augmentation, retrieving relevant text-image pairs to condition generation. Aims to achieve one-step high-quality text-to-image generation with reduced training costs.

entry.title: Evaluating Robustness of Reasoning Models on Parameterized Logical Problems

author.name: Na\"im Es-sebbani, Esteban Marquer, Yakoub Salhi, Zied Bouraoui

entry.summary: Introduces a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning on parameterized 2-SAT problems, isolating specific failure modes through controlled structural properties like contradiction cycles, free variables, and planted backbones.

entry.title: Leverage-Weighted Conformal Prediction

author.name: Shreyas Fadnavis

entry.summary: Proposes Leverage-Weighted Conformal Prediction (LWCP), which uses statistical leverage from the hat matrix to weight nonconformity scores for adaptive prediction intervals. Proves marginal validity, asymptotic conditional coverage, and recovery of standard CP.

entry.title: VimRAG: Navigating Massive Visual Context in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Multimodal Memory Graph

author.name: Qiuchen Wang, Shihang Wang, Yu Zeng, Qiang Zhang, Fanrui Zhang, Zhuoning Guo, Bosi Zhang, Wenxuan Huang, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Pengjun Xie, Ruixue Ding

entry.summary: Already analyzed above.

entry.title: 3DLAND: 3D Lesion Abdominal Anomaly Localization Dataset

author.name: Mehran Advand, Zahra Dehghanian, Navid Faraji, Reza Barati, Seyed Amir Ahmad Safavi-Naini, Hamid R. Rabiee

entry.summary: Introduces 3DLAND, a large-scale benchmark with 6,000+ CT volumes and 20,000+ 3D lesion annotations linked to seven abdominal organs. Uses a three-phase pipeline validated by radiologists with surface dice scores exceeding 0.75.

entry.title: RADAR: Revealing Asymmetric Development of Abilities in MLLM Pre-training

author.name: Yunshuang Nie, Bingqian Lin, Minzhe Niu, Kun Xiang, Jianhua Han, Guowei Huang, Xingyue Quan, Hang Xu, Bokui Chen, Xiaodan Liang

entry.summary: Proposes RADAR, an efficient evaluation framework for diagnosing perception and reasoning bottlenecks in pre-trained MLLMs without requiring supervised fine-tuning, revealing asymmetric development of abilities during pre-training.

entry.title: Annealing in variational inference mitigates mode collapse: A theoretical study on Gaussian mixtures

author.name: Luigi Fogliani, Bruno Loureiro, Marylou Gabri\'e

entry.summary: Provides mathematical analysis of annealing strategies for mitigating mode collapse in variational inference, deriving sharp formulas for mode collapse probability when learning Gaussian mixtures.

entry.title: Know More, Know Clearer: A Meta-Cognitive Framework for Knowledge Augmentation in Large Language Models

author.name: Hao Chen, Ye He, Yuchun Fan, Yukun Yan, Zhenghao Liu, Qingfu Zhu, Maosong Sun, Wanxiang Che

entry.summary: Proposes a meta-cognitive framework for knowledge augmentation in LLMs that partitions knowledge into mastered, confused, and missing regions using internal cognitive signals, then applies differentiated intervention and alignment.

entry.title: Agentic AI for Robot Control: Flexible but still Fragile

author.name: Oscar Lima, Marc Vinci, Martin G\"unther, Marian Renz, Alexander Sung, Sebastian Stock, Johannes Brust, Lennart Niecksch, Zongyao Yi, Felix Igelbrink, Benjamin Kisliuk, Martin Atzmueller, Joachim Hertzberg

entry.summary: Presents an agentic robot control system using reasoning-capable LLMs that plan and execute tasks through an iterative planner-executor loop, deployed on two physical robot platforms. Finds the approach is flexible but fragile under real-world conditions.

entry.title: SCOPE: Selective Conformal Optimized Pairwise LLM Judging
